title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role & How we work

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.

You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.

  • Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.

  • Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

  • Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.


The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.

  • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.


2 reasons why you should not apply

  • You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.

  • You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.


Your mindset

  • You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.

  • You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.

  • You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.

  • You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.

  • You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.


What we offer

  • Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.

  • Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.

  • A motivated, highly international team (15 nationalities) that gathers in person at our Berlin HQ and supports each other, with flat hierarchies and direct interaction with our management team and investors.

  • Visa sponsorship, relocation support, and a competitive compensation package with a meaningful variable component tied to fund performance.

title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
TL;DR

Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology.
We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked.
We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them.

The problem we're solvingLarge organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting.
GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow.
Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems.



What we're looking for

You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here.

You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions.

You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached.

You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them.

You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere.

You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence.

You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents.

You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to.



What you'll do

Over your first year:

  • Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on.
  • APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now.
  • AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work.
  • Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems.
  • Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen.
Our stack
  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, Playwright
  • Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Jest
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Sentry
  • Increasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflows
You don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack.


Requirements

  • Substantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js
  • Comfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORM
  • Can independently take a feature from unclear starting point to production
  • Can read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewrite

Nice to have:
  • Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scale
  • Exposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector search
  • Experience owning systems, not just features
Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point.


How we hire

How we workWe're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process.
Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early.

How we hireNo seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work.

  1. Intro. You, us, and whether this is the environment you're actually looking for.
  2. Technical conversation. We go deep on something difficult you've built: the decisions, the alternatives, what you'd do differently now.
  3. Technical assessment. Usually live coding on a realistic problem, sometimes a small proof of concept instead. We care how you think, not whether your solution matches ours.
  4. Offer. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move.

One last thingJob descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. If you're reading this thinking "I can do most of this, but I haven't worked with MCP", apply.
Strong fundamentals, meaningful software shipped, and a bias toward ownership are what we're looking for. The rest is learnable.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

title: Chief Technology Officer (all identities)
description:
Das erwartet Dich

Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working.

As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO.

Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice.

This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points.
  • Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation.
  • Build a strong leadership layer, clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies.
  • Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies.
  • Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified.
  • Plan the Engineering budget and capacity. Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity.
  • Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance.
  • Make credible commitments with Product. Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments.
  • Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early. Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights.
  • Establish clear data contracts with Data. Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science.
  • Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

  • Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems
  • Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings
  • Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence
  • Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective
  • Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality

Dein Profil

  • You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition.
  • You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact.

title: Projektmanagement / Innovationsmanagement
description:
Du hast Spaß daran, aus Ideen konkrete Projekte zu machen, Themen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit anderen neue Lösungen zu entwickeln? Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, und möchtest nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Wer wir sind

Unsere Mission ist es, die Veränderung hin zu einer nachhaltigen Welt aktiv und innovativ zu gestalten. Diese Veränderungen machen wir für uns und unsere Kund*innen als etwas Positives wahrnehmbar. Wir sind die Gamechanger für den nachhaltigen Erfolg unserer Kund*innen und damit auch für unsere Gesellschaft.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass aus Vorhaben Ergebnisse werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Ansprechpersonen zusammen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Planung, Koordination und Begleitung interner und externer Projekte
  • Strukturierung von Projektzielen, Aufgaben, Zeitplänen und Verantwortlichkeiten
  • Koordination der beteiligten Teams und Stakeholder
  • Sicherstellung von Fortschritt, Transparenz und verlässlicher Kommunikation
  • Identifikation von Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Verbesserungspotenzialen
  • Entwicklung und Bewertung neuer Ideen, Prozesse und Lösungsansätze
  • Begleitung von Innovationsprojekten von der Idee über erste Tests bis zur Umsetzung
  • Vorbereitung und Moderation von Workshops und Projektterminen
  • Dokumentation von Entscheidungen, Ergebnissen und nächsten Schritten
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden und Prozesse im Projekt- und Innovationsmanagement

Qualifikation

Uns ist weniger wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf einem bestimmten Muster entspricht. Entscheidend ist, dass du strukturiert arbeiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Menschen für gemeinsame Vorhaben zusammenbringen kannst.

Hilfreich sind:

  • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Innovationsmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten
  • klare und verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Freude daran, mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten
  • Neugier auf neue Technologien, Methoden und Geschäftsmodelle
  • die Fähigkeit, Ideen kritisch zu hinterfragen und gleichzeitig pragmatisch in die Umsetzung zu bringen
  • ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann Planung notwendig ist – und wann es besser ist, einfach anzufangen

Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Themen wirklich voranzubringen. Statt starrer Prozesse setzen wir auf Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Zusammenarbeit.

Du arbeitest an unterschiedlichen Projekten und hast dabei die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und Strukturen aktiv mitzuentwickeln.

Dabei suchen wir ausdrücklich keine Person, die lediglich Projektpläne pflegt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Zusammenhänge versteht, Verantwortung übernimmt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Ideen tatsächlich umgesetzt werden.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben unter Angabe deines möglichen Starttermins und wir werden uns zeitnah bei dir melden.

title: Steuerberater (all genders) bis zu 100% Remote
description:
Mission

Wir suchen eine:n ambitionierte:n Steuerberater:in, die/der gemeinsam mit uns die Schnittstelle zwischen Steuerfachwissen und Technologie neu definiert. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für operative Exzellenz und Qualitätssicherung und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Prozesse weiterentwickeln. Das ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, von Anfang an dabei zu sein und die Zukunft digitaler Steuerprozesse mitzuprägen.

Wir sind überzeugt: Technologie soll menschliche Expertise stärken, nicht ersetzen. KI kann Prozesse optimieren, aber niemals das Urteilsvermögen und die Erfahrung echter Steuerberater:innen ersetzen. Wir entwickeln Werkzeuge, die Steuerberater:innen ermöglichen, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren: fachliche Exzellenz, echte Mehrwerte und Arbeit, die wirklich zählt.

Deine Anstellung erfolgt bei der Integral Tax GmbH Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft.

Deine Aufgaben

Was du bei uns machst

  • Mandantenbetreuung: Kompetente Ansprechperson für steuerliche Fragen und strategische Beratung

  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung höchster Qualitätsstandards in allen steuerlichen Prozessen

  • Operative Exzellenz: Eigenständige Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und laufende Steuerberatung für unsere Mandanten

  • Prozessentwicklung: Aktive Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe, gemeinsam mit unserem strategischen Technologiepartner

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Einzigartige Kombination aus Steuerfachwissen und digitaler Innovation: Du arbeitest nicht nur im klassischen Kanzleialltag, sondern prägst aktiv mit, wie steuerliche Arbeit der Zukunft aussieht

  • Du kommst in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase zu uns und hast echte Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Flache Hierarchien mit echtem Ownership

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: mobil im Inland, mit einem modernen Büro in Berlin, wann immer du möchtest

 

Das macht deinen Job aus

Erfahrung & Mindset
Du hast deinen Steuerberater-Titel frisch in der Tasche oder stehst kurz davor und fragst dich, wo du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst. Du willst aktiv mitgestalten, wie die steuerliche Arbeit der Zukunft aussieht, und siehst KI und Automatisierung nicht als Bedrohung, sondern als Chance. Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

  • Bestellte:r Steuerberater:in (oder kurz davor) mit Erfahrung in DATEV oder vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst selbst mit an und scheust dich nicht vor operativen Aufgaben

  • Tech-Affinität: Du möchtest die Branche durch Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI aktiv vorantreiben

  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein: Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gern themen- und teamübergreifend mit Produkt- und Tech-Teams zusammen

  • Gestaltungswille: Du siehst in einer Gründungsphase eine Chance, Veränderung mitzugestalten

Was wir nicht suchen

  • Menschen, die Teamarbeit und kollegiale Unterstützung nicht wertschätzen

  • „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht"-Mentalität

  • Kein Interesse an Technologie oder künstlicher Intelligenz

  • Reines Delegieren ohne eigenes Engagement

Prozess

  1. Virtuelles Kennenlernen Call

  2. Onsite Interviews: Geschäftsführer der Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft kennenlernen, Fallstudie mit Team Leads der Steuerfachangestellten, Büro Tour und weitere Kolleg:innen kennenlernen

  3. Referenzgespräche

Unser Angebot

 

  • 28 Urlaubstage pro Jahr: der 24. und 31. Dezember zählen jeweils als halbe Tage

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge zu über 200 Partnern oder Deutschland Ticket: du entscheidest

  • Moderne Anlagen wie Windows Pro, große Bildschirme, und mehr

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV)

  • Mobiles Arbeiten im Inland und ein Arbeitsplatz in unserem Büro im Herzen von Berlin, wann immer du möchtest

  • Ein Team aus 50+ ambitionierten, diversen Menschen: wir lernen und bauen gemeinsam

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und stellen Menschen aufgrund ihrer Fähigkeit ein, eine Aufgabe zu erfüllen. Menschen jeder Herkunft, jeden Geschlechts, jeder geschlechtlichen Identität, sexuellen Orientierung, Religion, jeden Alters, mit Behinderung, jeder politischen Überzeugung oder jedem Familienstand sind bei Integral willkommen.

title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. 

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.

  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle

  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.

  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. 

  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.


Your profile

  • You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.

  • You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate. 

  • You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on.

  • With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you.

  • You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. 

  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.

  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.

  • You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack

  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. 

  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.

  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. 

  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.

  • You have basic dbt knowledge.



What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days 

  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other

  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute

  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice

  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.


If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren.

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Principal Data Engineer (m/w/d) - GIS / Geospatial
description:
Startdatum

Wir suchen Dich ab sofort an einem unserer deutschen Standorte in München, Nürnberg, Frankfurt am Main, Essen, Leipzig oder Berlin!


Deine Aufgaben

Data und AI sind Dein zu Hause? Deine neue Herausforderung gestaltet sich wie folgt:

  • Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Lösungen für die Verwaltung, Verarbeitung und Integration von Geodaten
  • Gestaltung von Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodellen für komplexe GIS-, 3D- und Infrastruktur-Daten
  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenintegrations- und Transformationsprozessen mit Technologien wie ArcGIS und FME
  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei der Auswahl und Weiterentwicklung geeigneter GIS-, Datenbank- und Systemarchitekturen
  • Analyse von Anforderungen und Übersetzung dieser in technische Zielbilder, Schnittstellen und Lösungskonzepte
  • Begleitung von Proof-of-Concepts, technischen Validierungen und der Überführung von Lösungen in den produktiven Betrieb
  • Moderation von Workshops und adressatengerechte Kommunikation technischer Zusammenhänge gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern
  • Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung in Projekten und aktive Einbringung Deiner Expertise in unsere Engineering Community


Dein Profil

Data ist in Deiner DNA? Das solltest Du mitbringen: 

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Geoinformatik, Data Engineering, Geodäsie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bildet die Grundlage
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Data Engineering, GIS, Geodatenmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld bringst Du mit
  • Im Umgang mit Esri ArcGIS verfügst Du über sehr gute Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit ArcGIS Pro und ArcGIS Enterprise
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit FME zur Transformation, Integration und Verarbeitung von Geodaten gehört zu Deinem Profil
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in relationalen und räumlichen Datenbanken, insbesondere PostgreSQL/PostGIS, zeichnen Dich aus
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Geodatenmodellen, Georeferenzierung, Koordinatensystemen und räumlichen Datenverarbeitungsprozessen runden Dein fachliches Profil ab
  • Gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python bringst Du ebenfalls mit
  • Im Bereich 3D-Geodaten verfügst Du über Erfahrung sowie idealerweise auch mit BIM-, CAD- und GIS-Integrationen
  • Erfahrung in der technischen Beratung, Systemkonzeption und Moderation von Workshops ist ebenfalls Teil Deines Erfahrungsspektrums
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien wie AWS oder Azure
  • Idealerweise verfügst Du über eine Zertifizierung im Esri- oder FME-Umfeld, z. B. als ArcGIS Enterprise Administration Professional oder FME Certified Professional
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch und Englisch sowie Reisebereitschaft im Rahmen einer Consulting-Tätigkeit runden Dein Profil ab


Wir bieten

Data bewegt uns! Was Dich auf Deiner persönlichen Journey erwartet, findest Du hier:

Work-Life-Balance
Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung - ob voll remote oder in einem unserer modern eingerichteten Innenstadtbüros (inkl. Dachterrasse), workation - nutze die Möglichkeit aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten
Kultur & Zusammenarbeit
Einzigartige Teamatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien zu unserem CEO Alex sowie eine offene Feedbackkultur, jährliche Teamworkshops auf unserem Data.Castle im Zillertal, gelebtes Data.Musketeer Prinzip – „einer für alle, alle für einen!“, unser [at] Buddy Programm zur besseren Vernetzung, regelmäßig stattfindende Fach- und Freizeitevents, hundefreundliche Büros
Fachliche & persönliche Entwicklung
Intensiver Onboarding- & Einarbeitungsprozess, persönlicher Entwicklungsplan und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, vielfältiges Workshop- und Schulungsangebot innerhalb der Data.Academy durch unsere erfahrenen Data.Musketeers sowie externen Anbieter, Führungs-, Projektleiter- und Expertenlaufbahn
Vergütung & Zusatzleistungen
Kita-Zuschuss, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Bezuschussung, zahlreiche Corporate Benefits & Mitarbeiterangebote (z.B. für Events und Reisen), Startguthaben in unserem internen Merchandise-Shop, kompetitives Gehalt mit variablen Anteilen
Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden
Mental Health & Wellbeing Support sowie Coaching und Meditation durch nilo.health, Fitness- und Yogaräume im Münchner Office, regelmäßige Mitarbeiterzufriedenheitsumfragen, EGYM Well Pass Mitgliedschaft mit Plus1 Option, Fahrradleasing über Jobrad nach der Probezeit, interne Gruppen für sportliche Aktivitäten, kostenlose Heiß- und Erfrischungsgetränke sowie frisches Obst im Office, Dachterrasse (mit Grill)
Mobilität
Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, zentrale Lage der Offices, gute Anbindung an den Öffentlichen Nahverkehr, Möglichkeit von anderen Standorten zu arbeiten


Ansprechpartnerin

Janine Sauer, Senior HR Managerin

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte
  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice
  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur
  • Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt


Deine Bewerbung 

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? 

Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.

title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)
description:
Introduction

Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting.
You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.


Your mission

  • The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
  • Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements
  • You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems
  • Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce
  • You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners


Your profile

  • You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements through to go-live
  • You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes
  • For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce
  • You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability
  • Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus
  • You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English


Why us?

  • Work Environment & Organization: You enjoy working in our Munich office and value face-to-face interaction with your team. In addition, you can work from home one day a week. You’ll have the freedom to manage your own schedule within the framework of our operational requirements.
  • Workation: Upon agreement, up to 4 weeks of EU workation per year are possible. If you choose Fuerteventura, we’ll also cover your flight, accommodations, and rental car.
  • Freedom & Responsibility: With us, you’ll take on responsibility, actively contribute your ideas, and work in an environment with short decision-making paths and no rigid processes.
  • Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths.
  • Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more.
Please note: The application process is coordinated centrally by the ValueNet Group.


Embracing Diversity Together

At ValueNet, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunity. We invite people from all backgrounds to apply—regardless of race, nationality, religion, beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. Diversity enriches our team and creates space for innovation and shared success.


Values that bring us together

For ValueNet, sustainability is more than just a word—it is an integral part of our actions, our products, and our services. Enthusiasm, trust, courage, and responsibility shape our culture. We are actively committed to fostering an inclusive environment that respects each individual’s uniqueness and strengthens our shared goals.

title: Praktikant (all genders) Editorial Research & Content Marketing
description:
Einleitung

Unity Advisory is a pure-play, experience-led CFO advisory firm providing integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support. We are free from audit conflicts and AI-enabled by design, combining deep technical expertise with automation, analytics and AI built into the delivery of every engagement. We are building an alternative to traditional advisory firms, focused on clarity over complexity, outcomes over hours, and practical advice delivered at pace for CFOs making high-consequence decisions.

The Role

As a Finance Transformation Manager, you will lead workstreams within high-impact transformation programmes — working directly with CFOs and their leadership teams to re-imagine and digitise finance functions through digital technologies, streamlined processes and modern operating models.

This is a client-facing role at a firm that does things differently. There are no legacy layers here — you’ll take real ownership, shape the work, and have direct visibility of the impact you create from day one. If you’ve built strong credentials in finance transformation and want to apply them somewhere that moves at pace and actually values your expertise, this is that role.

Responsibilities

• Advise CFOs and their leadership teams on transformation priorities and approach.

• Lead and manage finance transformation workstreams across process, data and technology.

• Design future-state finance operating models tailored to client context.

• Redesign core finance processes including R2R, P2P, O2C and FP&A.

• Implement cloud-based ERP and EPM platforms, automation tools, data platforms and analytics solutions.

• Translate business requirements into practical ERP/EPM solutions and integrate technology into clients’ ecosystems.

• Drive adoption of transformation initiatives so the changes stick after we leave.

• Run executive workshops and lead steering committee updates.

• Ensure delivery on time, on budget and within scope.

• Lead, coach and develop team members.

• Contribute to go-to-market activities, proposal writing and pitch presentations.

• Support thought leadership on EPM trends and tools.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of experience in finance transformation including 2+ years in a consulting or advisory environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-impact tech-enabled Finance Transformation programmes.

  • Experience implementing ERP, EPM, analytics tools and automation platforms.

  • Experience in process re-engineering and operating model design.

  • Finance/Accounting qualification including ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CPA

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Work Environment

A truly hybrid and flexible working environment. We offer the opportunity to be at the forefront of AI-driven advisory services. You’ll be working on cutting-edge projects and encouraged to deploy the latest analytical tools and approaches.

Additional Information

At Unity Advisory, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. In line with the Equality Act 2010, we will accommodate any suitable candidate requiring assistance to attend or conduct an interview. If you need any adjustments or support, please let us know when either scheduling your interview or in your application cover letter. We are dedicated to ensuring that everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and are here to support you throughout the process.
