title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Productivity
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
  • Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
  • Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
  • Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
  • Et d’autres fonctionnalités !

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.

title: Managing Director - France
description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

title: Product Manager Intern - Connect
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You'll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.

This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.


Your Impact

Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.

Your work will help the squad bring together the key information, questions, risks and opportunities before development begins.

Concretely, you will:

  • Help pre-qualify channels: Map the marketplace landscape by country and vertical, and contribute to a first-level assessment of each channel: technical integration effort, functional coverage with Mirakl Connect, and business potential (seller demand).
  • Explore channel requirements: Review channel API specifications and requirements across catalog, offers, orders and logistics, and test them hands-on (e.g. with Postman). With support from the team, identify key questions, dependencies, risks and areas that require further investigation.
  • Prepare build-ready inputs: Turn your analyses into useful inputs for the squad, such as data mappings, process diagrams, edge cases, open questions for channel partners and first drafts of user stories."
  • Talk to the field: Interview sellers, Sales and Customer Success teams, and channel partner teams to turn scattered feedback into clear insights and product recommendations.
  • Contribute to channel builds: Alongside the Channel Integration PM and the squad, help refine specifications and user stories, contribute to backlog discussions, answer functional questions and participate in QA and go-live preparation.
  • Build AI-powered tools to scale channel work: Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and prototyping. For example, you may help create an agent that analyzes channel documentation, a Q&A assistant for Sales and Customer Success or AI-assisted prototypes to explore mappings and integration flows.

What Success Looks Like

  • After 3 months: A broad set of channels pre-analyzed at a high level, with a first assessment of technical integration effort and functional coverage, contributing to channel pre-qualification
  • After 6 months: Several channels analyzed in depth and handed over to the squad as build-ready, an active contribution to channel builds, and at least one AI tool in daily use by the team


What You'll Bring to the Role

Profile & Experience

  • Currently pursuing a gap year internship or end-of-studies internship (engineering school, business school or university)
  • Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces and retail
  • A structured mindset, with the ability to turn a broad or ambiguous question into a clear and actionable analysis
  • A genuine curiosity for understanding how products, processes and systems work
  • Previous experience in a start-up or scale up, in e-commerce, consulting, business analysis or project work is a plus, but not required


Technical Skills

  • Hands-on with APIs: You understand what an API is and how systems exchange data, and you can read API documentation and make simple API calls (e.g. with Postman). Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus.
  • Data and spreadsheet skills: You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus.
  • Hands-on with AI tools: You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Curious, proactive and rigorous: You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences.
  • Fast learner with adaptability: You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts.
  • Critical thinker: You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses.


Languages

  • Fluent English is mandatory, both written and spoken, as it is our working language with the team and channel partners.
  • Another European language is a plus.

Compensation

Monthly stipend range: €1,200 - €1,400


Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to this role, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter and then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application
  2. TA interview (30-45 minutes) to discuss your experience and answer your questions about Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 minutes) with one of the Product Managers to dive deeper into the role and assess technical fit
  4. STAR interview (45 minutes) to evaluate alignment with our values and team culture
  5. Offer

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? 

Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.
30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events

title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization.
Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions.


What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability
  3. Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
  4. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts.
  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.


What success looks like

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.
  2. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation.
  3. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business.
  4. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams.
  5. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working.


What it takes

  1. A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field.
  2. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus.
  3. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving.
  4. Curiosity about business needs and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  5. Confident communication in English and German.
Bonus:
  1. Initial experience with optimization methods, LLM-based data extraction, or uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
  2. Familiarity with real estate, building physics, or energy systems.
  3. Experience with tools for physical simulation or energy modeling.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. The models you build feed straight into our product and get used by real customers. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Über die Stelle

Pflege ist eines der größten gesellschaftlichen Probleme unserer Zeit. marta ist die führende Plattform, die den intransparenten Markt für 24-Stunden-Betreuung radikal verändert. Wir machen Pflege einfacher zugänglich, transparent und bezahlbar.

Wir haben viel ausprobiert und viel gelernt. Performance-Marketing läuft. TV haben wir zwei Jahre lang mit echtem Druck gefahren. Mailing, Print und Partnerschaften kennen wir aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Fallstudien. Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.

Start: so bald wie möglich


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.

Was du machst

  • Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
  • Kanäle planen und koordinieren. Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
  • Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu. 
  • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.


So sieht Erfolg aus
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.
Nach 6 Monaten: die Markenbotschaft steht und ist an allen Kontaktpunkten sichtbar, zwei bis drei eigene Kampagnen sind live, und das Performance-Marketing arbeitet mit frischem Material statt mit denselben drei Anzeigen.
Nach 12 Monaten: marta hat eine Kampagne, die Familien wiedererkennen, der YouTube-Kanal wächst und liefert Material, das in anderen Kanälen weiterläuft, Branded und Direct Traffic steigen, und neue Quellen liefern verlässlich mehr als 3.000 zusätzliche Leads pro Monat..


Das bringst du zu uns mit

Auf diese fünf Punkte schauen wir. Alles danach ist ein Plus und kein Filter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre in Marke, Kampagnen oder Content. Agentur oder inhouse, beides passt. Die Jahre sind nicht das Kriterium, die Arbeiten sind es.
  • Arbeiten, die du selbst gemacht hast, nicht nur verantwortet: Texte, Kampagnen, Videos, Seiten. Zwei bis drei davon würden wir gern sehen.
  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau, C2) und kannst eine Idee so aufschreiben, dass andere sie umsetzen können.
  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal außerhalb von Paid Search aufgebaut oder getestet: Mailing, Print, Partnerschaften, Events, Podcast oder TV. Du legst Erfolgskriterien vorher fest und brichst auch mal ab.
  • Du hast mit externen Dienstleistern gearbeitet: auswählen, briefen, Budget führen, Qualität beurteilen.

Das hilft zusätzlich
  • Du hast selbst einmal einen Social-Media-Account aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht, beruflich oder privat.
  • Du hast eine Marke mitgestaltet und weißt, wie aus Farben, Designelementen und Sprache ein stimmiges Bild wird.
  • Erfahrung in CRM und Lifecycle (HubSpot, Klaviyo, Superchat oder Vergleichbares).
  • Video und Social sind dir nicht fremd. Du erkennst ein Format, das trägt, und bekommst es auch mit kleinen Mitteln umgesetzt.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Content-Produktion und ein klares Urteil, wo sie trägt und wo nicht.
  • Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen, emotionalen Entscheidungen. Lead-Gen statt reinem E-Commerce.
  • Erfahrung im Verhandeln von Media-, Sponsoring- oder Produktionsbudgets.
  • Englisch C1 für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Wenn du bei ein oder zwei Punkten unsicher bist: bewirb dich und schreib uns, wie du dir das aneignen würdest. Wir entscheiden nach deinen Erfahrungen und unserem Gespräch, nicht nach einer Checkliste.
Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn
  • du mit einem Rebranding anfangen willst. Logo und Farben sind nicht unser Engpass. Der Engpass sind Kampagnen und Kanäle.
  • du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch.
  • du am liebsten in einer Disziplin bleibst. Dein Feld reicht von der Mailing-Strecke bis zum Gespräch mit einem Sender.
  • du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung.
  • du lange Abstimmungsschleifen brauchst. Die Wege sind kurz, dafür entsteht viel in kurzer Zeit.


Warum marta?

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP nach Jahr 1) und Performance-Bonus
  • 27 Urlaubstage
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Zugang zu Fitness, Studios und Wellbeing
  • Ein internationales Team mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig
  • Unser Prozess
  • Fachgespräch, kurze Kampagnenaufgabe, Kennenlernen mit den Gründern, Reference Calls. Wer im Prozess sitzt, sagen wir dir vorher. Entscheidung in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Deine Bewerbung
Schick uns zwei bis drei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist, und in zwei Sätzen, warum. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick alles an Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder Lebensweg. Wir bauen bewusst ein Team, das die Familien widerspiegelt, für die wir da sind.
