title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.
  • Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team.
  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.
  • Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function.
  • Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like.
  • 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing,  are all familiar territory for you.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision.
  • Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it.
  • English at C1 level or above

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone.
  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch


What you can expect from us


  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!
  • Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility.
  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 
Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach.
Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen.


Ihr Profil

Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil.


Warum wir?

Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht.

Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat.

Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

title: Technical SAP Product Owner (m/w/d)
description:
Als Technical SAP Product Owner (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Weiterentwicklung unseres Natuvion DCS Produktportfolios. Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern, Partnern, Kunden sowie funktionsübergreifenden Delivery-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte echten Mehrwert schaffen und Natuvion strategisch voranbringen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Verantwortung für die Produktvision, Strategie und Zielerreichung eines oder mehrerer Produkte innerhalb des Natuvion DCS Portfolios rund um den Themenkomplex SAP Datenmigration & -transformation (inkl. Anonymisierung, Validierung und Vervielfältigung von Daten)

  • Definition, Verwaltung und Priorisierung des Product Backlogs mit starkem Fokus auf Kundennutzen und Business Impact

  • Zentrale Ansprechperson für Service Owner, Kunden, funktionsübergreifende Delivery-Teams, Vertrieb, Marketing und Partnerunternehmen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Technical Lead, um Prioritäten in skalierbare, qualitativ hochwertige und technisch umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen

  • Aufbereitung von Initiativen in Epics und User Stories sowie Anforderungsklärung in Zusammenarbeit mit technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern

  • Sicherstellen, dass Backlog‑Items der Definition of Ready entsprechen und ausgelieferte Features die Definition of Done erfüllen

  • Interne und externe Repräsentation des Produkts sowie selbstbewusste Kommunikation von Fortschritten, Prioritäten und Ergebnissen


Dein Profil:

  • Studium der (Wirtschafts‑) Informatik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im SAP/ABAP‑Umfeld, idealerweise mit praktischem Entwicklungs‑Background

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Product Thinking, Backlog‑Management, Requirements Engineering und Priorisierung

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, zwischen fachlichen und technischen Perspektiven zu vermitteln

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit analytischem, lösungsorientiertem Denken

  • Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Erfahrungen als Product Owner oder Technical Lead von Vorteil

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Falls du denkst, dass du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst: Bei uns sind deiner Entwicklung „keine Grenzen gesetzt“! Geh mit uns gemeinsam deinen Weg – Wir unterstützen dich dabei! Zeige uns einfach wer du bist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Umfeld, dass jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandenen Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne!

Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst:

  • Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit 

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub 

  • FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten 

  • Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen 

  • Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion 

  • Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung 

  • Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen 

  • Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig  

  • Uns ist deine langfristige Perspektive wichtig, deshalb bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen 

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion ist ein digitales Umzugsunternehmen.

Unser Team bewegt keine Tische, Aktenschränke oder Stühle. Natuvion transportiert geschäftskritische Daten und Prozesse von einer Technologieplattform auf eine andere. Typische Natuvion „Umzugsdienstleistungen“ umfassen Datenmigration, Datentransformation, Datenintegration, Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Datenqualität.

Unsere >400 BeraterInnen und EntwicklerInnen in Deutschland, Österreich, Slowakei, USA und Australien verfügen über weitreichendes Knowhow bei (SAP®-)Projekten und ein profundes Prozessverständnis über Branchengrenzen hinweg. title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.



 

The Impact You Will Have:

As an Agentic Software Engineer on the Platform Architecture squad, you will build the multi-agent systems that autonomously refactor and modernize Sonar's own codebase — starting with one of our biggest technical bets: unifying SonarQube Cloud (SQC) and SonarQube Server (SQS) onto a single, portable architecture ("build once, deploy twice"). You will:

  • Design and build agentic refactoring pipelines that can safely extract a domain's logic from our existing SQS/SQC codebases and re-platform it onto our Unified Core (a hexagonal "capability-core + adapters" architecture), with minimal human oversight.

  • Define the guardrails that make autonomous refactoring safe at scale — verification gates, automated test generation, static analysis, and rollback strategies that let agents move fast without breaking production code relied on by 7M+ developers.

  • Prove the approach on real migrations — Micronaut-to-Spring conversions, Lambda-to-container consolidations, API convergence (consolidating overlapping API surfaces onto shared contracts), and strangler-fig domain extractions — before scaling it into a repeatable, multi-agent "coding squad" capable of tackling many domains in parallel.

  • Stay hands-on in the Java/Spring codebase often enough to critically review what the agents produce, recognize when a refactor is architecturally wrong, and correct the agentic loop that generated it — not just the output.


What You Will Do

  • Spend the majority of your time (roughly 70%) designing, building, and iterating on agentic tooling: orchestration, tool-use, context management, and evaluation harnesses for autonomous code-modification agents.

  • Build and refine the verification layer that gates what agents are allowed to ship — automated test generation, regression detection, static analysis (using our own SonarQube), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where warranted.

  • Spend the remainder of your time (roughly 30%) hands-on in our Java/Spring codebase: reviewing agent-generated pull requests, fixing what they get wrong, and feeding those lessons back into the tooling.

  • Partner closely with the Server, Cloud Platform, and value-stream squads whose domains you're migrating — earning their trust and buy-in matters as much as the code itself.

  • Contribute to the Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and standards that govern how our platform evolves.

  • Track and evaluate emerging agent frameworks and techniques, bringing back what's genuinely useful — as distinct from what's just hype — for accelerating engineering across Sonar.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating multi-agent or LLM-agent systems in a real production setting — not just prompting a coding assistant, but designing the orchestration, tool-use, and guardrails around autonomous agents.

  • Experience building evaluation or verification systems for AI-generated changes: automated testing, static analysis, regression detection, or comparable safety nets for code you didn't personally write.

title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 
Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach.
Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen.


Ihr Profil

Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil.


Warum wir?

Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht.

Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat.

Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig.

description:
Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH

 

Munich or Berlin

Language requirement: Fluency in both German & English

 

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

 

The Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations across the DACH region.

You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams.

You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities

  • Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups

  • Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

  • Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

  • Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum

  • Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers on solution design

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility

 

What we’re looking for

  • Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

  • Fluent in both German and English

  • Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

  • Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions

  • Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

  • Structured, strategic approach to deal management

  • High ownership and accountability for outcomes

 

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

 

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close that gap. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. title: Security Engineer
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You will own security engineering end-to-end across application, infrastructure, and incident response: partnering with product and platform teams during design, writing and shipping security automation in production, and leading high-quality response when something breaks. Day to day, you will help define security in a greenfield modern bank, moving beyond threat modeling, harden cloud and CI/CD paths, build detection and response workflows, and drive remediation to closure with clear risk tradeoffs. This role reports to the CISO. What matters most is measurable risk reduction that keeps product velocity high.

 

Your First Six Months

Understand the foundations and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: Enforce an SSDLC that codifies existing security goals across EU-live payment/ledger services and US launch-critical services into required design, build, and release checkpoints (ownership, control evidence, and exception handling), with 100% of net-new Tier-1 changes following the workflow.

  • Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.

  • Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

 

This role is for you if:

  • You can point to security automation you personally built that replaced recurring manual review work.

  • You have strong product security fundamentals and can improve secure-by-default patterns in fast-moving engineering teams.

  • You have led end-to-end rollout of security controls in production, from design and implementation through adoption and evidence.

  • You regularly influence architecture decisions before launch through fast, lightweight risk reviews and pragmatic controls.

  • You are comfortable writing production-grade code or infrastructure changes, not only policy or tickets.

  • You use AI tooling to accelerate security reviews and remediation planning without lowering quality or signal.

  • You push ambiguous work forward without waiting for a complete playbook, and you bring stakeholders with you.

This is not for you if:

  • You prefer advisory-only security roles and do not want direct implementation ownership.

  • You need tightly scoped tickets to make progress and are uncomfortable defining the plan yourself.

  • You avoid ownership of production systems and control implementation work.

  • You optimize for stability over change and are not excited by early-stage ambiguity.

 

Hard Requirements

  • Extensive experience in hands-on security engineering, product security, cloud security, or detection/response engineering in production environments

  • Demonstrated expertise securing cloud-based systems (IAM, networking, logging, key management, workload isolation) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Proven experience building at least one security automation or detection capability that is actively used in production

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment with audit and control evidence requirements

  • Experience with modern security tooling, especially SIEM/SOAR and cloud security platforms

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) Berlin and able to work in-office 3 days/week

 

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software), you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services.

You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers.

In this role, you will:

  • Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage.

  • Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites.
  • Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value.
  • Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required.
  • Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matter, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and applies pragmatic judgment.

  • You bring 4+ years of relevant quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation experience.
  • You have experience building or contributing to automation frameworks and maintaining automated test suites.
  • You understand and can apply the full Software Testing Life Cycle, including functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • You can analyze end-to-end architectures, user flows and integrations, identify quality risks and translate them into appropriate test coverage.
  • You have hands-on experience with automation tools  and frameworks such as Pytest, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or REST Assured.
  • You are comfortable configuring and maintaining test environments and test data.
  • You have experience executing performance or load tests.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, communicate clearly and raise risks early.
  • You enjoy investigating complex issues, challenging assumptions and balancing thoroughness with pragmatism.
  • You collaborate openly with engineers and other stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Python or JavaScript and Git
  • UNIX or Linux environments
  • Agile product development environments
  • Test documentation tools, especially TestRail
  • AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Testing embedded systems, IoT devices, mobile applications or connected hardware ecosystems


Why us?

  • Diversity and inclusion: Diversity is core to us and one of the reasons for our success.

  • Office events: In addition to our summer and winter parties, smaller office events are part of everyday life at ProGlove.


What success looks like

  • Quality risks are identified early, communicated clearly and addressed before they affect customers.

Meet your team

The team values hands-on collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of product quality. You will contribute your perspective early in the development process, help the team understand quality risks and work together with colleagues to turn requirements and user flows into practical, maintainable test coverage.

description:
Join SE3 Labs as Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Perception

Take on SE3's hardest perception problems as a hands-on technical leader, and ship systems that work on real missions.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Perception, you'll set technical direction for SE3's perception stack across object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation, and spend around 80% of your time building it yourself. You'll work closely with our perception lead, founders and autonomy engineers, shaping architecture and core algorithmic decisions without people-management responsibility. Your work moves from recorded data to field trials and determines how well our platforms understand their surroundings.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Architecture & Algorithms: Shape the architecture of the perception stack and drive core algorithmic decisions together with the team lead.

  • Detection & Tracking: Build object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Develop semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a dependable picture of the scene.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Design the evaluation and replay loop so the team iterates mostly on recorded data, with clear metrics, benchmark datasets and regression tests.

  • Real-World Deployment: Optimize models for onboard compute and take them through field trials until they work under real operating conditions.

  • Technical Roadmap: Contribute to the perception roadmap by identifying the problems that matter most for field performance.

  • Technical Leadership: Raise the engineering bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers by example.

     
 

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of hard problems and want to solve them hands-on, spending most of your time designing, coding and testing.

  • You hold a Ph.D. with 3+ years of industry experience, or an M.Sc. with 6+ years, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • You have a proven record of building perception systems that shipped and worked in the real world, in robotics, autonomous driving, AR/VR, drones or adjacent domains.

  • You bring deep expertise across modern perception, including object detection, tracking, segmentation and depth estimation, and you base design decisions on evaluation data.

  • You lead through technical influence, setting direction, reviewing designs and helping others grow, without needing a management role.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. You'll take technical ownership of the data platform behind how we run the business: the pipelines, the warehouse, and the definitions behind the numbers our leadership team actually uses.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work alongside a colleague who owns the business-facing side of data, plus our infrastructure and application engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role with no line management in either direction, roughly 70% hands-on building, 30% defining, documenting and explaining.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

JUPUS supports hundreds of law firms across Europe, and our customer base is growing roughly 4x a year. Our data platform has grown with it (ClickHouse, dbt, Python extract-load pipelines into an S3 data lake, orchestration in GitHub Actions) and it has grown fast.

Your job is to make it trustworthy. That means modernising what already exists, making historical trends a record of what actually happened rather than a nightly re-derivation of it, and owning the definitions behind the metrics that reach our board. This is not a greenfield build, and it is not a maintenance seat. It is a real platform with real problems, and you would own it.

Tasks

  • Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and the raw layer, the ClickHouse warehouse, and the dbt project on top of it. You're the person who can say whether a number is wrong or the pipeline is.

  • Make our numbers trustworthy: reliability, correctness, and a history that holds up, so that a trend is a record of what actually happened rather than a re-derivation of it.

  • Own the metrics the company runs on, starting with our customer health score- the definition, the denominator, the eligibility rules and the known limitations, not just the SQL underneath them.

  • Turn business questions into durable metrics: work directly with Customer Success, Sales, Product and leadership to understand what they're actually trying to decide, then build something defensible enough to decide on.

  • Keep cost and complexity in check as we grow: warehouse architecture, query cost, and the surfaces that deliver data into BI and our CRM. All of it gets harder as the customer base multiplies.

  • Set the standard for how data work is done here: one authoritative written definition per leadership-visible number, and the conventions that inform our Data function as it grows with us.

Requirements

Technical Expertise

  • Substantial experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production ownership of a warehouse and a transformation layer. We care more about evidence of ownership than about years served.

  • ClickHouse in production.

  • dbt at ownership level: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, CI/CD. Ideally you've inherited someone else's dbt project and left it better than you found it.

  • Python data engineering: EL tooling, S3, CI-based orchestration that you’ve owned end to end, with no platform team behind you.

  • Product event streams: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or similar. You understand how user-to-company identity and group association break, and what that does to every metric downstream.

Judgement and Ownership

  • You have defined a business KPI end to end and defended it to non-technical people. This is the differentiator for us. An excellent engineer who takes requirements as given is not the right fit for this role.

  • Analytical rigour: cohorts, correct denominators, sample size stated before findings. You'll say "we can't tell yet, and here's exactly why" rather than produce a confident chart.

  • You act without waiting for a ticket, and you can name something you chose to stop doing.

  • You're comfortable in front of senior stakeholders, including C-level, and can hold a technical line without losing the room.

Further Requirements

  • Located within CET +/-2.

  • Nice to have: BI tool administration (we use Metabase), CRM and billing systems as data sources, dlt specifically, GDPR-driven data deletion work, Grafana, German, or B2B SaaS and legal-tech domain experience.

  • Nice to have: you're used to non-technical colleagues querying data through AI tools, and you design for that.

Benefits

🎯 Metric Ownership – Own a business-critical metric end to end, definition included — not just the pipeline that feeds it.

🛠️ A Real Platform – ClickHouse and dbt already in production, with genuine problems worth solving. No greenfield theatre, no maintenance seat.

⚡ Direct Access – A flat structure and a direct line to our Head of Engineering, CTO and CEO. No committee between you and a decision.

📈 Growth Stage – Roughly 4x customer growth a year at one of Europe's fastest-growing AI legal tech companies.

🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere

💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need

🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle

If you're excited about owning the numbers an AI startup runs on and delivering the data that guides us in our scaling journey, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.

You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams.

  • Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working.

  • Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed.

  • Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention.

  • Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions.

  • Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership.

  • Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams.

  • A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems.

  • Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update.

  • Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds.

  • Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process.

  • Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time.

  • The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems.

  • Rust experience.

  • Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes.

  • Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators.

  • Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows.

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!

We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time.

Trusted by leading brands like Siemens Healthineers, Koro, and Jack Wolfskin, we've achieved 2x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

At traide AI, we believe customs specialists deserve smarter, faster workflows and the future of global trade depends on it. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in builing robust, AI-powered backend services and infrastructure that drives the value creation for our customers. Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application.

You'll join a tight-knit, VC-backed B2B startup - calm but ambitious - where your ideas shape both product and culture.

Product Development

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release
  • Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases
  • Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects
  • Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience
  • Partner with AI engineers to bring cutting-edge research and prototypes into production-ready features
  • Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind
Code quality & technical excellence

  • Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team

  • Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale

  • Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents

  • Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient

  • Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers

Knowledge sharing

  • Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows


Who we’re looking for

You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day.

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally building complex products in dynamic environments
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type-level programming
  • Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, HTTP APIs (REST and GraphQL), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns.
  • Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, and the services that typically come with them.
  • You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies
  • You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback
  • Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required
  • Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc.
Our Tech Stack:
  • React & Chakra UI (Component library)
  • GraphQL
  • Node.js & Prisma (ORM)
  • Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy
  • Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages
  • Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform


Why us?

  • Varied day-to-day: Every feature comes with unique technical challenges → no two days are the same
  • Visible impact: You'll see the direct results of your work → for both our customers and traide AI
  • Direct impact on product: Your technical decisions shape what we ship and how it performs
  • Team culture: You'll be part of a team that communicates transparently, values humor, and supports each other with respect and sincerity

title: Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d)

title: Mechanical Engineer  | Robotics
description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

  • Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape).
  • Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range.
  • Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing.
  • Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups.
  • Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing.
  • Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development.

Requirements

  • Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it.
  • Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it.
  • Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot.
  • Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production.
  • Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench.
  • Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools.
  • Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production.
  • How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware.
  • Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket**.**
  • Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new materials, processes, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, health, food, or fitness. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us your CV and a few projects you've worked on. Ideally, include a mechanical system you designed and built yourself, with a short note on the challenges and how you solved them. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call → Technical deep-dive → On-site visit → Offer

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering and tech. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: TikTok Content Creator & Video Editor (m/w/d), Werkstudentenstelle
description:
Werkstudentenstelle · 15–20 h/Woche · 100 % remote

Über FLOWZOOM

Wir sind FLOWZOOM – eine Marke für hochwertige, innovative Reiseprodukte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Reisekissen, die Komfort, Funktionalität und ansprechendes Design verbinden. Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

Creatives-Erstellung:

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)
  • Du drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos für unseren TikTok Shop Brand Account
  • Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community
  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse:

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert – damit wir Creator-Briefings schärfen, unsere eigenen Videos verbessern und die stärksten Videos mit Ads boosten können
  • Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Unterstützung im Creator Management:

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

  • Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:
  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn
  • Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"
  • Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content
  • Unser Ton: lustig, schnell und abenteuerlustig, aber ehrlich. Wir zeigen, was das Produkt wirklich kann.

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es läuft

  • Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt
  • Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren
  • Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert
  • Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)
  • Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und du sprichst fließend Englisch (unsere Teamsprache)
  • Du bist immatrikuliert

Nice-to-have:

  • Du nutzt gern AI-Tools, die dir das Leben leichter machen – etwa um bei Ideen, Analyse oder Recherche Zeit zu sparen
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Affiliate- oder Creator-Marketing

Nicht erforderlich:

  • TikTok-Shop-Erfahrung. Ein Hintergrund in Content, Social Media oder E-Commerce zählt genauso.

Konditionen

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, remote, flexible Zeiteinteilung
  • Werkstudium: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

Benefits

Wie wir ticken

  • Wir bauen auf der Meinung unserer Kunden auf: Customer Insights und das, was ihr Feedback uns zeigt, sind der Motor für alles, was wir erstellen
  • Wir leben Ownership, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Transparenz
  • Wir arbeiten als Team zusammen – und trotzdem jeder eigenständig und fokussiert
  • Und das Beste: Wir arbeiten 100 % remote und sind flexibel bei den Arbeitszeiten

Was dich erwartet

  • Ownership über unseren Brand-Kanal und unserer Affiliate-Engine: Wir bauen von Grund auf neu und du prägst, wie das aussieht
  • Direktes Feedback: Jede Woche siehst du, was deine Videos erreichen und was deine Arbeit bewirkt
  • Ein internationales, entspanntes Team ohne komplizierte Hierarchien

Retail Sales Manager / Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zunächst Kund:innen in Berlin mit großartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn und entdecke die neuesten Updates im Wolt Deutschland Newsroom.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

  • Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.
  • Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.
  • Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.
  • Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst: Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.
  • Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.
  • Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.
  • Qualifikation & Sprache: Studium oder Ausbildung, fließendes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir anbieten:

  • Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels: Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.
  • Wachstum & Impact: Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten Märkte in Berlin auf das nächste Level.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Arbeite selbständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.
  • Mobilität & Equipment: Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone & MacBook) und die Option auf einen Firmenwagen für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.
  • Wolt-Benefits: Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

Nächste Schritte

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screening: Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: Ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager, in dem wir mehr über deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation für die Rolle erfahren möchten.
  3. Role Play: Eine praxisnahe Sales-Übung, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einwänden zeigen kannst.

Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?

Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spaß verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!

Wichtiger Hinweis: Um deine Daten bestmöglich zu schützen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschließlich unsere Karriereseite für deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
