title: Kfz-Mechatroniker Hyundai (m/w/d)
description:
Lust auf Leistung

Nord-Ostsee Automobile ist Teil der internationalen Van Mossel Automotive Group, einer der erfolgreichsten Automobilhandelsgruppen Europas. Gemeinsam verbinden wir regionale Stärke mit internationaler Kompetenz und gestalten die Mobilität von morgen.

 

Mit den Marken Mercedes-Benz, AMG, Aston Martin, Hyundai, smart, IVECO und weiteren starken Partnern bieten wir unseren Kundinnen und Kunden ein umfassendes Mobilitätsangebot. Dabei stehen für uns exzellenter Service, Innovation und nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen im Mittelpunkt.

 

Als Arbeitgeber setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen ihre Stärken einbringen, sich weiterentwickeln und gemeinsam Erfolge erzielen können.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft für Technik und Fahrzeuge auf die Straße.

Bei Nord-Ostsee Automobile arbeiten wir nicht einfach an Fahrzeugen – wir sorgen täglich dafür, dass Menschen mobil bleiben. Als Teil unseres Werkstattteams bringen Sie Ihr Können dort ein, wo Präzision, Leidenschaft und modernste Technik aufeinandertreffen. Wenn Sie Benzin im Blut haben und Premium-Service leben möchten, dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig.


Das ist Ihr Auftrag

  • Effiziente Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten

    Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an Fahrzeugen der Marke Hyundai. Mit Präzision und technischem Verständnis stellen Sie sicher, dass jedes Fahrzeug unseren hohen Qualitätsstandards entspricht.

  • Präzise Fehlerdiagnosen

    Sie führen fundierte Diagnosen an mechanischen, elektrischen, elektronischen, hydraulischen und pneumatischen Systemen durch. Probleme erkennen Sie schnell, analysieren diese strukturiert und sorgen für eine zuverlässige Behebung.

  • Qualitätsorientierte Umsetzung

    Sie arbeiten sorgfältig nach Herstellervorgaben und internen Qualitätsstandards. Ihr Anspruch: perfekte Arbeit bis ins Detail – für maximale Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Teamorientierte Zusammenarbeit

    Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihrem Werkstattteam zusammen, bringen Ihr Know-how aktiv ein und unterstützen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Gemeinsam sorgen Sie für einen reibungslosen Werkstattablauf.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung

    Sie bleiben technisch am Puls der Zeit und entwickeln sich kontinuierlich weiter. Schulungen und neue Technologien sehen Sie nicht als Pflicht, sondern als Chance.



Das bringen Sie mit

  • Sie sind ausgebildeter Kfz-Mechatroniker (m/w/d) oder verfügen über eine vergleichbare handwerkliche Ausbildung.

  • Sie sorgen durch Ihre verantwortungsvolle und gewissenhafte Arbeit für die Sicherheit der Fahrzeuge unserer Kunden.

  • Sie denken lösungsorientiert und sind ein guter Teamplayer.

  • Idealerweise haben Sie erste Erfahrungen mit Mercedes-Benz spezifischen IT-Systemen im technischen Bereich – dies ist jedoch kein Muss.

  • Teamarbeit ist für Sie selbstverständlich. Gleichzeitig bringen Sie Eigeninitiative mit, denken lösungsorientiert und gehen neue Aufgaben offen und engagiert an.

  • Sie haben Freude daran, Service auf hohem Niveau zu bieten und möchten gemeinsam mit uns jeden Tag ein positives Kundenerlebnis schaffen.

  • Sie haben Lust auf Leistung und sehen Veränderungen als Chancen.

Mehr als ein Job – das erwartet Sie bei uns

Nord-Ostsee Automobile steht für Qualität, Innovation und Premium-Service – und genau das leben wir jeden Tag. Bei uns erwartet Sie ein Umfeld, das Leistung fördert, Entwicklung ermöglicht und Wertschätzung spürbar macht:

 

  • Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit neuester Technik und digitalen Tools - inklusive iPad, eigener Werkzeugkiste und hochwertiger Arbeitskleidung mit Wäscheservice

  • Weiterkommen statt stehen bleiben: Individuelle Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und echte Entwicklungsperspektiven in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Mehr drin für Sie: Attraktive Vergütung nach Haustarif, Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, & Corporate Benefits sowie exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Fahrzeuge, Teile und Services

  • Auch mal abschalten: 30 Tage Urlaub sowie Zusatzurlaub bei besonderen Lebensereignissen

  • Gesund & fit im Alltag: Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsangebote, Sportevents, Mental Health Coaching, Bike-Leasing sowie kostenlose Getränke

  • Auch an morgen gedacht: Ausbildungsplatzgarantie für die Kinder unserer Mitarbeitenden

  • Gut ankommen im Team: Strukturierte Einarbeitung und Onboarding-Day für neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Mitarbeiterevents (z. B. Weihnachtsfeier, Grillen, Teamevents) und ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit starkem Teamgeist

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem erfolgreichen Unternehmen

Gestalten Sie mit uns Mobilität auf hohem Niveau

Klingt nach dem richtigen Umfeld für Sie? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt hier über unsere Karriereseite mit Ihren vollständigen Unterlagen und werden Sie Teil unseres Teams.

description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

As our Founding Marketer, you make sure telli shows up in the market with the same quality, speed, and ambition with which we build our product.

You turn ideas into campaigns, launches into momentum, and content into pipeline. You work closely with founders, Product Marketing, and Marketing Ops to bring telli’s story into the market across content, events, social channels, and our website.

This is a broad, hands-on role. You do not wait for perfect briefs. You take ownership and make things happen.

what you'll do

Own campaigns: you plan and execute marketing campaigns across email, social, website, events, partnerships, and paid channels.

Build our content engine: you create and distribute newsletters, founder content, customer stories, videos, webinars, blog posts, and social content.

Turn launches into moments: you work with Product Marketing to execute launches across every relevant customer-facing channel.

Own events and field marketing: you organize webinars, dinners, conferences, and customer events from idea to follow-up.

Build telli’s founder brand: you turn founder ideas, customer conversations, and market insights into high-quality content.

Run creative projects: you develop campaign concepts and create strong assets yourself or with support from freelancers, agencies, and AI tools.

Improve our public image: you create and update landing pages, campaign pages, and conversion journeys together with Product Marketing and Marketing Ops.

Experiment with new channels: you test new formats, partnerships, campaigns, and distribution opportunities, and scale what works.

Measure impact: you work with Marketing Ops to understand which activities create attention, pipeline, and revenue.

what makes you a great fit

You have 3+ years of experience in marketing, ideally in a B2B startup or scaleup.

You are an excellent writer: you can turn rough ideas into strong copy in both German and English.

You have taste: you know what high-quality content, design, and brand execution look like.

You are a maker: you are comfortable writing the first draft, building the page, editing the asset, or launching the campaign yourself.

You are creative and structured: you generate strong ideas and reliably deliver them on time.

You are AI-pilled: you use AI to research, write, design, automate, analyze, and move faster.

You have commercial sense: you understand that marketing exists to acquire, convert, and grow customers.

You work autonomously: you do not need detailed instructions to make progress.

You have high agency and high urgency: you unblock yourself, keep momentum high, and focus on what matters most.

You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin.

You only want to own one marketing channel.

You prefer managing agencies to doing the work yourself.

You need a detailed brief and several rounds of sign-off before starting.

You enjoy ideation more than execution.

You are uncomfortable juggling multiple projects at once.

You do not enjoy writing or working directly with customers.

You want to work remotely. We’re an in-person team.

title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most.

What You Will Learn to Understand

Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for:

  • How LLMs actually behave: tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input.

  • Agents, tools, and retrieval: how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break.

  • Cloud software in production: APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control.

  • Inference and compute: what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers.

  • Daily operational tasks: resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking why until you do.

How the Year Works

Onboarding: Learn the platform by supporting it. You go through an intensive onboarding into our products, the underlying models, and the support queue. You shadow your first tickets, get to know our systems, and start resolving real customer issues. Expect plenty of experimenting, plenty of questions, and a steep learning curve.

Post-Onboarding: Own the queue and take on sidequests. Alongside the queue, you start picking up work from other teams: tasks below the threshold for a specialist to own but too valuable for your learning to ignore. This includes taking a sales call for a new lead, running a short customer workshop, building customer use cases, writing internal documentation, building internal agents, and further building out our own AI support tooling. As our inference and cloud offering grows, you will increasingly help customers understand and adopt it.

What You Will Do

  • Front-line customer support. Spend most of your day in the queue, handling customer tickets end-to-end across model behavior, API integrations, enterprise compliance, billing, and access control.

  • Investigate what is happening under the hood. Reproduce issues, compare model behavior, read logs and API responses, and separate "the model did something unexpected" from "the system did something wrong." Then give users clear, empathetic, and accurate answers.

  • Explain AI to the people who use it. Help customers understand non-determinism, model limits, context handling, latency, and model choice in plain language, so they can use AI with confidence.

  • Take on cross-team sidequests. Pick up the real work that falls between teams, like a small inbound sales call, a customer workshop, a piece of documentation, or an internal automation. These tasks are small in scope, but you fully own them.

  • Escalate to engineering and product. Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and report bugs directly to the engineers building our platform and infrastructure.

  • Improve support with AI. Propose practical improvements to our support workflow and build and test the internal AI tooling that helps resolve routine questions faster.

What Graduation Looks Like

You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. The program is designed so that strong performance turns into a permanent contract in a business department that suits your strengths: AI Adoption Management, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Recruiting, RevOps, Operations, Solutions Engineering, or elsewhere in the Business team.

We are expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do, with chat, agents, meetings, code, and apps; and down the stack, into our own cloud, compute, and inference. Wherever you land, you will bring something rare: a deep, hands-on understanding of how AI and AI infrastructure actually behave for real customers.

We make the decision together based on your performance in the queue, how you handled sidequests, and whether the team you want to join has a role for you. So far, AI Associates have graduated into Account/AI Adoption Management, Sales and Solutions Engineering. We are looking to broaden the program as a gateway into all business functions.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are fascinated by how AI works. You have gone down rabbit holes on why models behave the way they do, and you want a job where that curiosity is the core of the work.

  • You want to understand the stack, not just the surface. Cloud software, APIs, and inference interest you, and you are excited to learn how models are served, scaled, and made fast and reliable.

  • You are genuinely excited about front-line AI support. You take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through a busy ticket queue.

  • You think in systems and love analysis. You enjoy breaking down tricky technical or operational problems and figuring out what is really happening under the hood.

  • You show high agency and full ownership. You see a ticket through from first message to resolution and dig into root causes so the same issues do not keep coming back.

  • You experiment constantly. You try new models, automations, and tools, and you instinctively look for ways technology can make work easier.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus and useful in the queue.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

What We Need

  • Availability to start full-time and work 100% on-site at our Berlin office for the full 12 months.

  • A work permit for Germany.

  • Technical or analytical grounding. Studies or hands-on experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or a track record of building technical projects, is a plus but not a requirement. Curiosity about how AI and cloud systems work is.

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next Steps

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If you want to spend a year truly understanding AI, from the conversation down to the compute, we would love to hear from you.

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Alpha Plant Systems Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Shape the architecture of the world’s first net energy gain stellarator by taking full responsibility for the design, integration, and delivery of Alpha’s ancillary systems. You will own the system-level decisions that determine how breakthrough technology is integrated and delivered.

Taking accountability for the tritium fuel cycle, high voltage electrical power, heating sources, cryogenic and non-cryogenic cooling systems, and waste water treatment, you will also take total ownership of the complexity between them and the stellarator: the piping, distribution networks, and critical infrastructure that connect them. You will lead the team of teams translating the needs of Alpha into the physical delivery of major ancillaries, bridging in-house talent and external contractors.

As Senior Agile Transformation Manager, you are a leader, coach, and facilitator supporting Product Managers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.  

You ensure Agile principles are effectively implemented while helping teams become increasingly autonomous, predictable, and high-performing at scale.  

You are passionate about continuous improvement, organizational agility, and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Facilitate cross-functional planning and delivery across the software and hardware portfolio, aligning product management strategy and roadmap with engineering execution. 

  • Establish and continuously improve a scalable planning and delivery model grounded in Agile and Lean principles, encompassing product development, governance, system integration, testing, and release management. 

  • Identify systemic impediments, organizational bottlenecks, and cross-team dependencies, partnering with senior leaders and functional owners to drive resolution. 

  • Coach senior leaders, Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and delivery teams on Agile leadership, outcome-based planning, prioritization, and effective decision-making.  

  • Establish and monitor transparent measures of organizational delivery health, flow, quality, predictability, and release performance, using insights to drive corrective action and continuous improvement. 

  • Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous learning across the product development organization



What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.  

  • 5+ years scaling Agile in organizations with 50+ developers and multiple cross-functional teams. 

  • Experience designing, adapting and improving development frameworks for complex engineering environments. 

  • Significant experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Release Train Engineer, Delivery Lead, or similar role within a growing mid-sized or large organization. 

  • Strong knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and Agile principles. 

  • Ability to coach leaders and teams without directing execution. 

  • Proven success supporting cross-functional software and hardware product teams. 

  • Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills. 

  • Experience using Jira and Confluence.  

  • Experience with SAFe, LeSS, or other scaled Agile frameworks is a plus. 


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • Senior Agile Transformation Manager


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: EU Regional Training Lead (Vertriebstrainer/in)
description:

Bei Norgine verändern wir seit mehr als einem Jahrhundert das Leben von Patientinnen und Patienten. Die Position

Als EU Regional Training Lead (Vertriebstrainer/in) entwickeln und implementieren Sie wirkungsvolle Lernlösungen zur Stärkung von Commercial Excellence, Kundenorientierung und Führungskompetenz in mehreren europäischen Märkten. Sie übernehmen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Verankerung der Norgine-Frameworks für In-Call Effectiveness (ICE), Key Account Management (KAM) und Omnichannel Excellence und stellen sicher, dass unsere Teams über die erforderlichen Fähigkeiten und das notwendige Selbstvertrauen verfügen, um erfolgreich zu sein.

Requirements

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung regionaler Trainings- und Kompetenzentwicklungsstrategien.
  • Konzeption und Durchführung praxisnaher Lernprogramme zu Vertriebskompetenzen, Produktwissen, Kundeninteraktion und Führungsentwicklung.
  • Förderung der Implementierung der ICE-, KAM- und Omnichannel-Frameworks in der gesamten Region.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Führungskräften zur Identifikation von Kompetenzlücken und Umsetzung gezielter Entwicklungsmaßnahmen.
  • Weiterentwicklung der Field Force Excellence Training Academy einschließlich Onboarding-Programmen und Karriereentwicklungspfaden.
  • Nutzung von Coaching, Leistungsanalysen und Kompetenzbewertungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Wirksamkeit von Trainingsmaßnahmen.
  • Sicherstellung, dass alle Trainingsaktivitäten den Qualitäts-, Compliance- und regulatorischen Anforderungen von Norgine entsprechen.

Fähigkeiten & Erfahrung

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit:

  • Abgeschlossenem Hochschulstudium oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation bzw. Berufserfahrung.
  • Fließenden Englischkenntnissen sowie idealerweise guten Französischkenntnissen.
  • Erfahrung in pharmazeutischen kommerziellen Funktionen, beispielsweise im Vertrieb, Market Access, Vertriebsmanagement, Gebietsmanagement oder in den Bereichen Commercial Excellence bzw. Business Intelligence.
  • Nachweislicher Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Vertriebstrainings, Field Coaching oder Lern- und Entwicklungsprogrammen.
  • Fundiertem Verständnis pharmazeutischer Vertriebsprozesse, kommerzieller Leistungskennzahlen und Kundeninteraktionsmodelle.
  • Expertise in Moderation, Coaching, Präsentationstechniken und Stakeholder-Management.
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit LMS-Plattformen, CRM-/CLM-Systemen sowie datenbasierten Ansätzen zur Kompetenzentwicklung.
  • Fähigkeit, erfolgreich mit unterschiedlichen Ländern, Kulturen und Stakeholder-Gruppen zusammenzuarbeiten.

Unsere Werte leben

Erfolg bei Norgine bedeutet, unsere Werte jeden Tag zu leben:

Drive

  • Verantwortung übernehmen und Ergebnisse erzielen.
  • Zeitnahe, unternehmerisch sinnvolle Entscheidungen treffen.
  • Engagement und Verantwortungsbewusstsein fördern.

Dare

  • Konstruktiv hinterfragen und neue Denkweisen einbringen.
  • Mut zeigen, komplexe Herausforderungen anzugehen.
  • Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung vorantreiben.

Develop

  • Effektiv über Teams und Märkte hinweg zusammenarbeiten.
  • Unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Erfahrungen wertschätzen.
  • Klar kommunizieren und andere dabei unterstützen, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten.

Benefits

Warum Norgine?

Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, die Kompetenzentwicklung in ganz Europa maßgeblich zu beeinflussen, organisatorische Transformationen zu unterstützen und kundennahe Teams dabei zu unterstützen, bessere Ergebnisse für medizinisches Fachpersonal und Patientinnen und Patienten zu erzielen.

Wenn Sie sich für Lernen, Coaching und Commercial Excellence begeistern, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Head of Marketing & Communications (gn) | Renewable Energy
description:
IDEEMATEC ist einer der weltweit führenden Hersteller von Utility-Scale-Solartrackern und weltweiter Technologieführer im Bereich Agri-PV. Unsere Tracker bieten einzigartige Vorteile wie hohe Zuverlässigkeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus und daraus resultierende niedrige Stromgestehungskosten (LCOE).
Als Wegbereiter für kommerzielle Solartracker in der Landwirtschaft erschließen wir mit unseren Agri-PV-Lösungen ein neues Marktsegment und verbinden kostengünstige Energieerzeugung mit landwirtschaftlicher Nutzung.
Mit mehr als 10 GW installierter Projekte weltweit treten wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase ein. Neben den internationalen Märkten hat Deutschland als unser Heimatmarkt eine hohe strategische Priorität.

Unsere Kunden sind Independent Power Producers (IPPs), große Projektentwickler, EPC-Unternehmen, Utilities und strategische Investoren. Gemeinsam mit ihnen entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nicht nur einzelne Projekte optimieren, sondern ganze Projektportfolios effizienter, resilienter und wirtschaftlicher machen.

Wir wachsen international und suchen Menschen, die unternehmerisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Generation globaler Solarinfrastruktur gestalten möchten.
Technologie in Kundennutzen übersetzen, die Marke international schärfen, IDEEMATEC als Stimme der Solartracker- und Agri-PV-Branche positionieren: In Marketing & Communications entscheidet sich, wie Kunden, Partner und künftige Mitarbeitende uns wahrnehmen.

Als Head of Marketing & Communications (gn) verantwortest du die globale Marketing- und Kommunikationsfunktion von IDEEMATEC und führst das bestehende Team. Gemeinsam mit Product Management und Sales übersetzt du unsere Technologie in überzeugende Value Propositions und sorgst dafür, dass diese Botschaften die richtigen Kunden, Märkte und Stakeholder erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an den Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) – eine Funktion, die derzeit interimistisch durch unseren CEO wahrgenommen wird.

Dein Arbeitsplatz ist einer unserer drei bayerischen Standorte: Ismaning, Neusling oder Plattling

Aufgaben

Strategie, Marke & Kommunikation

  • Eigenständige Weiterentwicklung der globalen Marketing- und Kommunikationsstrategie und Ableitung von Prioritäten für unsere internationalen Märkte
  • Verantwortung für Marke, Positionierung, Corporate Identity und Corporate Design von IDEEMATEC für einen weltweit konsistenten Auftritt über alle Kontaktpunkte
  • Steuerung von Presse- und Medienarbeit, Corporate Storytelling und Thought Leadership, inklusive Unterstützung der Kommunikation der Geschäftsführung
  • Verantwortung für Website (inkl. SEO und KI-Auffindbarkeit), Corporate Content und unsere Präsenz auf LinkedIn
  • Gestaltung der internen Kommunikation, u. a. Town Halls, sowie Weiterentwicklung unserer Arbeitgebermarke gemeinsam mit HR

Customer & Product Marketing

  • Übersetzung von Produkten und Technologien in überzeugende Kundennutzen und Value Propositions entlang Kennzahlen wie Yield, LCOE, IRR und Projektrisiko – gemeinsam mit Product Management und Sales
  • Entwicklung global nutzbarer, regional anpassbarer Vertriebs- und Marketingunterlagen (Präsentationen, Whitepapers, Case Studies, Referenzmaterialien) für unsere internationalen Sales Teams

Events & Kampagnen

  • Entwicklung und Steuerung von Kampagnen zur Marktbearbeitung und Leadgenerierung gemeinsam mit Sales
  • Verantwortung für unser internationales Messe- und Veranstaltungsportfolio (u. a. Intersolar Europe, RE+, GENERA, KEY Rimini, Solar Power Africa sowie relevante Agri-PV-Formate), inklusive Zielsetzung je Auftritt und Nachbereitung mit Sales
  • Public Affairs & Verbände
  • Repräsentation von IDEEMATEC in Verbänden, institutionellen Netzwerken und Wirtschaftsdelegationen sowie frühzeitige Identifikation relevanter politischer und regulatorischer Entwicklungen

Steuerung & Führung

  • Eigenständige Verantwortung für Budget, Agenturen, Dienstleister und Marketing-Technologie inklusive Schnittstelle zum CRM
  • KPI-basierte Wirkungsmessung und Berichterstattung an die Geschäftsführung
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung und Weiterentwicklung deines Teams sowie Ausbau von Marketing und Kommunikation

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

title: Client Partner
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it.

Our customers do not buy software, they buy a change in how their organization runs. Automating core processes end-to-end frees capacity that was locked in manual execution. Consolidating fragmented point solutions onto one platform lowers what the process landscape costs to own. And running those processes with full transparency gives finance something it rarely has, a reliable real-time view of what is actually happening, which is what makes forecasting and financial steering possible.

Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to.

You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion across a focused portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Join late-stage commercial discussions, shape the delivery approach with the Account Executive, and own the client kick-off.

  • Hold the steering committee seat and the relationship with the client's CFO, COO or Head of Shared Services.

  • Act as the trusted advisor and domain expert your clients call before they call anyone else.

  • Orchestrate the functions that serve your accounts, project management, integrations, consulting and support, without managing them directly.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

  • Turn your best accounts into reference customers: case studies, referenceability, and clients willing to speak publicly about blp.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Ownership Without Authority – You deliver a number that depends on people who do not report to you, and you do it without escalating.

  • Executive Presence – You hold a room where a client executive is unhappy, and you leave it with a decision rather than an action item.

  • Commercial Instinct – You see the expansion before the client asks, and you can build the business case for it.

  • Structured Thinking – You break an ambiguous client situation into a plan with owners and dates.

  • Customer-First Mentality – You care about the client's business outcome, not about defending the project scope.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, enterprise customer success or account leadership, or senior delivery roles with commercial accountability.

  • Proven track record of owning senior client relationships in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

  • Experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with executive sponsors.

  • Credible on enterprise finance and supply chain processes. You do not need to configure an ERP, but you need to understand how one is used.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience in ERP, AP automation, or AI-driven enterprise SaaS.

How You Grow

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. From here the paths lead into leading a team of Client Partners, into senior commercial roles, or into leading a delivery or consulting function. Many of our Client Partners come from Senior Project Manager or Senior Consultant roles, and we are explicit about what that step requires.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Client Partner
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it.

Our customers do not buy software, they buy a change in how their organization runs. Automating core processes end-to-end frees capacity that was locked in manual execution. Consolidating fragmented point solutions onto one platform lowers what the process landscape costs to own. And running those processes with full transparency gives finance something it rarely has, a reliable real-time view of what is actually happening, which is what makes forecasting and financial steering possible.

Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to.

You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion across a focused portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Join late-stage commercial discussions, shape the delivery approach with the Account Executive, and own the client kick-off.

  • Hold the steering committee seat and the relationship with the client's CFO, COO or Head of Shared Services.

  • Act as the trusted advisor and domain expert your clients call before they call anyone else.

  • Orchestrate the functions that serve your accounts, project management, integrations, consulting and support, without managing them directly.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

  • Turn your best accounts into reference customers: case studies, referenceability, and clients willing to speak publicly about blp.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Ownership Without Authority – You deliver a number that depends on people who do not report to you, and you do it without escalating.

  • Executive Presence – You hold a room where a client executive is unhappy, and you leave it with a decision rather than an action item.

  • Commercial Instinct – You see the expansion before the client asks, and you can build the business case for it.

  • Structured Thinking – You break an ambiguous client situation into a plan with owners and dates.

  • Customer-First Mentality – You care about the client's business outcome, not about defending the project scope.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, enterprise customer success or account leadership, or senior delivery roles with commercial accountability.

  • Proven track record of owning senior client relationships in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

  • Experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with executive sponsors.

  • Credible on enterprise finance and supply chain processes. You do not need to configure an ERP, but you need to understand how one is used.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience in ERP, AP automation, or AI-driven enterprise SaaS.

How You Grow

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. From here the paths lead into leading a team of Client Partners, into senior commercial roles, or into leading a delivery or consulting function. Many of our Client Partners come from Senior Project Manager or Senior Consultant roles, and we are explicit about what that step requires.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Your Career Path in Consulting

Our Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take your first own customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

  • Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

  • Senior Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the Consultants and Specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

  • Next steps: Lead a Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Your Mission

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our Consulting team sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

This is also where our AI meets the real world, and the real world is messy. When a customer goes live, our agents start processing their documents: invoices, order confirmations, delivery notes, in dozens of formats from thousands of suppliers, with layouts nobody has seen before. Most of it works immediately. The rest is where we come in.

A concrete example. Our AI learns a customer's business logic from their own history. By reading how they have accounted invoices in the past, blp infers the rules they have been applying and makes them explicit. Sometimes it cannot close the loop on its own, because the same kind of invoice was historically booked in two or three different ways and there is no consistent rule to find. In those cases blp asks. It needs the answer once, and every future case follows it. Making sure that answer arrives, and that it is the right one, is our job. Done well, each of those conversations builds trust and removes a category of manual work permanently.

You are hands-on in the automation itself. You configure and tune the agents so they work for a specific customer, dig into exceptions until you find the actual cause rather than patching the symptom, and run automation sprints: the push after each go-live to the target automation rate, and focused sprints our customers book to take their automation further.

You are in front of customers from early on: running the sessions that explain what a new capability does, taking the open questions our AI raises to the person who can decide them, and chasing down why automation is not landing, whether that is a master data problem, a habit, or a process rule that no longer makes sense. You use data-driven insights to decide which conversations to have with customers and which improvements to prioritize.

You work alongside a Consultant on your accounts and build process and platform depth on real customers from the first month.

Key Responsibilities

Automation and performance

  • Configure and tune agents so they work for a specific customer's documents and processes.

  • Drive and own the push after each go-live, from first live volume to the target automation rate, and deliver the automation sprints our customers book.

  • Resolve the open questions our AI raises about a customer's business logic: take the cases to the customer, get the decision, and make it permanent.

  • Drill into root causes when automation stalls, and tell a master data problem from a process rule from a behavior.

Customer health and growth

  • Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

  • Act as run lead and escalation point for your customers once they are live.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Spot expansion opportunities and bring in Sales, and work alongside the Client Partner on strategic accounts.

Account economics

  • Secure and monitor service consumption against the agreed budgets.

  • Scope automation sprints and additional services, and make sure paid work is billed.

Team and platform

  • Work with our Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and feed recurring patterns back to Product.

  • As a Consultant, direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

  • Process Excellence – You understand core business processes, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not.

  • Growth Mindset – You learn fast, ask when you are stuck, and get better every month.

We're looking for a driven, curious, and impact-focused Senior Account Executive to join our growing team. You'll play a key role in driving revenue growth across mid-market and enterprise accounts by helping organizations automate their ERP processes with AI. At blp, you'll take full ownership of the sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close, and directly shape how the next generation of companies operates.

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

title: Account Specialist - Berlin
description:
About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.


What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

  • Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

  • Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

  • Support restaurants for the first month after the go live

  • Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

  • Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

  • You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

  • You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

  • You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

  • Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

  • Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

  • Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

  • Flexibility in working hours to fit our merchants’ needs

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

  • You are comfortable working in both German and English

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/de/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible Time-off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Consultant - Automotive Value Chain Transformation (f/m/x)
description:
accilium is a management and strategy consultancy founded on the belief that nothing is built to last unless it is built to evolve. That is why we have been driving the mobility and energy transition for nearly a decade. Through transformation projects that accelerate digitalization and position organizations for the future. We rethink organizations, put technology at the center, and always keep the people in mind. For us, change is not a matter of will, but of the ability to continuously evolve.

Together with our ventures &amp and accilium ventures, we operate at seven locations in Germany, Austria, Poland, and Romania and employ 110 people. According to Statista and brand eins, accilium ranks among the best management consultancies in the German-speaking world and is part of the “Hidden Champion of Consulting 2026/27”.

Why launch your career at accilium?

At accilium, you will help build something big. We move fast – and we will take you along on our journey working with top-tier clients and engaging in diverse projects. We foster an open team culture, place the highest value on your professional development, and always meet on equal footing.

You will work on one of the largest transformation programs in the automotive industry, supporting one of the world's leading automotive OEMs. Our projects focus on areas where engineering, product data, and vehicle software are being fundamentally transformed, ranging from the harmonization of engineering and IT landscapes to Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV) and the entire automotive value chain.

These initiatives come with complex challenges. Target architectures must be aligned across brands, domains, and numerous stakeholders while remaining stable over time. Legacy systems must be replaced in a structured way while business operations continue uninterrupted. At the same time, software-centric development approaches are changing established processes and responsibilities. We ensure that architecture and implementation are aligned, decisions are well prepared, and progress remains transparent.

Together with your project team, you will take ownership of customer challenges from day one. You can always rely on leadership support, coaching, and continuous feedback to accelerate your development. We believe in full transparency when it comes to your career. Your progression all the way to Senior Consultant in the Automotive Practice is determined solely by your individual performance.

Your responsibilities

You will work closely with the project team and project management and quickly take ownership of your own workstreams.

  • Target Vision & Dependencies: Support the development of target architectures and roadmaps while creating transparency regarding dependencies across topics, teams, and systems.

  • Transition Management: Support the migration from legacy systems and processes into future-state target architectures, including business cases and transition planning.

  • Requirements & Decision Management: Maintain requirements and prioritization structures, document decisions, and keep key project artifacts up to date.

  • Analysis: Analyze existing system and process landscapes and develop decision papers and business cases.

  • Tracking & Reporting: Build progress dashboards and reporting structures and prepare management reports.

  • Presentation & Facilitation: Create concise decision-making materials and increasingly facilitate workshops and alignment sessions with business and IT stakeholders.

  • Project Management: Apply project management methodologies and structure content and interdependencies within the overall project framework.

  • Functional Consulting: Develop concepts and provide consulting support as a trusted sparring partner for the client.

What is in it for you?

SALARY

  • Full‑time monthly gross salary starting at € 4.650 (including 30 vacation days), depending on your experience and qualifications.

  • Annual salary increase + bonus (up to one month’s gross salary or 10 additional vacation days).

Because we value your commitment.

CAREER PATH & DEVELOPMENT

  • 100% transparent career path (company-wide standard) + Individual People Year instead of fixed promotion cycles.

  • A People Partner who provides guidance on career direction and development focus from day one.

  • Professional training, internal training formats, semi-annual performance reviews, and management 1:1s to accelerate your learning curve from day one.

  • Regular feedback, direct access to partnership, and a culture of change to foster your growth.

Your career and development are a priority.

IMPACT & VISIBILITY

  • We are big enough to deliver real impact, yet agile enough for everyone to actively shape the future.

  • AI is part of our daily work. We implement AI for our clients and grow internally to achieve our goal of becoming an AI‑first consultancy.

You witness real change and authentic decision‑making processes.

ONBOARDING

  • Buddy will assist you with onboarding and introduces you to our resources, organizational structure, and tools.

  • Latest hardware and software: Surface, iPhone & home‑office equipment available from day one.

Structured onboarding for a smooth start.

COMMUNITY & BENEFITS

  • Public transport ticket & corporate benefits.

  • 80/20 smart working rule (1 home office day per week available).

  • Events like reTreat, acc’sPerience, and our Christmas party create real connection.

  • Office breakfasts and after‑work gatherings strengthen the local community and encourage exchange.

  • Work from Anywhere option for flexible work models (up to 10 days per year from within Europe).

At accilium, community is real - not just a buzzword.

What makes a great fit

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering with a technical or IT focus, Business Informatics, or a comparable field of study.

  • Experience: At least one internship or working student position with a reputable management consultancy. Additional experience with an automotive manufacturer or supplier is an advantage.

  • Technical Understanding: Foundational knowledge of Systems Engineering, IT Architecture, or engineering and product data processes, gained through your specialization, thesis work, or practical experience.

  • Analytics & Tools: Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, combined with an interest in structured data analysis and visualization.

  • Good to have: Experience with Jira and Confluence, basic knowledge of Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) or TOGAF, and familiarity with agile frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe.

  • Languages: Excellent German and English skills (at least C1 level).*

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about consulting and eager to deep‑dive into the consulting field.

YOUR APPROACH

  • Growth Mindset: Curiosity, a commitment to continuous learning, and the willingness to go the extra mile during demanding project phases.

  • Industry Passion: A genuine enthusiasm for the automotive industry, ideally demonstrated through internships, working student positions, thesis work, or extracurricular activities such as Formula Student.

  • Soft Skills: Strong communication and problem-solving capabilities, combined with flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic, stakeholder-rich environment.

  • Willingness to Travel: Flexibility to travel within the DACH region (depending on specific project needs).

At accilium, we nurture your personal growth and provide guidance every step of the way.

Why accilium?

accilium is an award-winning strategy and management consultancy shaping the future of mobility and energy. Driven by a strong mission, we prioritize teamwork and continuous learning. Our growing team of more than 110 experts has become a rising star in the consulting industry, and we are excited about the increasing attention we are receiving.

title: Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik (m/w/x)
description:
Die Alveon MedTech GmbH ist ein innovatives Medizintechnik-Startup mit Sitz in Ostfildern bei Stuttgart. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung medizinischer Inhalationssysteme. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 haben wir erfolgreich eine patentgeschützte Basistechnologie entwickelt. Aktuell arbeiten wir – im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft mit einem der größten deutschen Unternehmen im Medizinalcannabis-Markt – an der Entwicklung und Zulassung des ersten dosierfähigen Cannabis-Inhalators für den europäischen Markt.

Jetzt steht die entscheidende Phase an: Versuch, Verifikation und Zulassung. Dafür bauen wir unser Labor in Ostfildern aus und suchen jemanden, der dort die Prüftechnik in die Hand nimmt.

Als Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik verantwortest du unsere Versuchs- und Prüfaufbauten: Du baust sie, du führst die Versuche durch, du wertest sie aus und dokumentierst sie belastbar. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt eindeutig im Labor und am Prüfstand. Ergänzend konstruierst du Vorrichtungen und Bauteile und baust Prototypen auf.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO und Entwicklungsleiter zusammen, in einem kleinen Team mit kurzen Wegen. Einkauf und Lieferantenqualifizierung liegen bei Kolleginnen und Kollegen – du lieferst die technische Bewertung.

Aufgaben

Schwerpunkt: Versuch, Prüfaufbau und Labor

  • Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen, Messplätzen und Versuchsständen

  • Aufbau und Betreuung der Messtechnik inklusive Kalibrierung und Prüfmittelverwaltung
  • Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von Prüfkampagnen bei externen Laboren und Hochschulen
  • Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, Versuchsprotokollen, Prüf- und Entwicklungsberichten

Ergänzend: Konstruktion und Prototyping

  • Konstruktion von Vorrichtungen, Adaptern und Bauteilen im CAD
  • Prototyping mittels 3D-Druck sowie Aufbau, Kennzeichnung und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Mustern
  • Technische Bewertung von Bauteilen und Werkstoffen aus Keramik, Spritzguss und Silikon
  • Zuarbeit zur technischen Dokumentation gemäß MDR und ISO 13485

Qualifikation

Damit du in dieser Position erfolgreich bist, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Physik) oder Technikerabschluss mit einschlägiger Erfahrung

Besonders von Vorteil sind:

  • Erfahrung mit Aerosolen, Inhalation, Thermodynamik oder Strömungstechnik
