title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
description:
What we're building

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that turns machine and operational data into knowledge people can act on: for troubleshooting, for decisions, and for automation.

We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding team.

The role

You'll build the software that makes sense of what happens on a manufacturing floor. That includes sensor measurements, actuator states, quality measurements, and operational events, streamed from connected machines and autonomous systems. Our platform processes this data to power analysis and automated workflows.

We work AI-first. Our coding agents know our platform and our engineering practices, and you'll use them every day. You're still the engineer, though. You'll review every line, understand what it does, and test it properly. That frees you to focus on the application, the industrial domain, and the quality of the system.

We care about what you can show, how fast you learn, and whether you take ownership. Seniority and years of experience matter less.

What you'll do

  • Own features end to end: understand the problem, choose the approach, then build, test, ship, and follow up

  • Get to know the existing codebase in depth, including its architecture, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes

  • Write code with AI tools and review each change line by line for correctness, maintainability, security, and impact on the wider system

  • Build meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and wire them into CI

  • Test against messy real-world data, using recorded streams, representative datasets, and simulated devices. Cover missing or delayed measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values, and dropped connections

  • Reproduce failures, fix them, and add regression tests so they don't return. Make sure tests reflect the intended behavior, and challenge the assumptions in the implementation

  • Build and improve backend services, APIs, and data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval, and automated workflows

  • Learn how our users and their factories work, so you can spot the right improvements and make good engineering calls

  • Help wherever it's needed: integration, deployment, documentation, and technical investigation. Flag progress, capacity, trade-offs, and blockers early

You might be a fit if you

  • Write strong, practical Python and understand the advanced features and patterns used in production code

  • Have built and maintained substantial software: finding your way in an existing codebase, debugging behavior you've never seen before, and shipping reliable changes

  • Think like a tester: you turn requirements into test cases, set sensible test boundaries, build useful test data, and dig into failures

  • Have solid fundamentals in software design, APIs, data handling, testing, debugging, and version control

  • Can explain what code does, why it works, where it could break, and how to verify it, including code an AI helped write

  • Like AI coding tools, use them a lot, and stay critical of their output, because you own the result

  • Break down unfamiliar problems, investigate on your own, and ask sharp questions when you need to

  • Find the next useful step yourself and keep moving without being told what to do

  • Are comfortable with shifting priorities, varying workloads, and a broad scope, and communicate and prioritize clearly

  • Write and speak clear English

A degree is optional. We care about evidence that you can engineer, not about a title or a specific path.

Bonus points

Depth in one of these areas makes you a particularly strong candidate. We don't expect all three.

  • ML and industrial data: strong ML fundamentals and hands-on work with time-series, sensor, machine, or robotics data. You've dealt with data quality, evaluated models, and turned results into useful product behavior

  • Agents, autonomous systems, and industrial automation: agent coordination, workflow orchestration, state management, or failure handling. IIoT experience, such as telemetry pipelines, device interfaces, MQTT, or OPC UA, is a big plus

  • Knowledge graphs and retrieval: knowledge representation, graph database design, schema and relationship modeling, graph queries, or retrieval that connects structured knowledge to what the application needs

Also useful: cloud deployment, containers, and testing software against simulators or physical devices.

Why now

You'll be one of the first engineers. Your code goes to production, and your decisions shape the product and how we build it. You'll work directly with the founders from day one. We'll tell you more about the company, the founders, and our backers in the first conversation.

title: Corporate Development Manager - Strategy, Finance & AI Operations (m/f/d)
description:

  • Degree in business, finance, economics or a related field

Benefits

  • Direct collaboration with the leadership team and exposure to all key decisions

  • The opportunity to build a modern, AI-first finance and operations function from the ground up
  • A growing company in the Private Markets ecosystem, working with renowned asset managers and wealth institutions

About Privatize

At Privatize, innovation and financial expertise come together to shape how Private Markets are distributed to wealth clients. We offer a professional, supportive environment with flat hierarchies, room for personal development and the opportunity to make a real impact.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & Full-Funnel Growth - 100% remote
description:
Wir sind eine stark wachsende Direct-to-Consumer-Marke im Gesundheitsbereich und verkaufen hochwertige Supplements direkt an unsere Kund:innen. Unsere wichtigste Wachstumsmaschine: Direct-Response-Marketing über Meta Ads.

Ein hoher ROAS ist für uns kein Ziel – meistens ist er ein Zeichen dafür, dass zu wenig ausgegeben wird. Wir steuern auf Wachstum: Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und ein CAC, der sich am Kundenwert misst. Wenn du ohnehin in Deckungsbeiträgen und CAC/CLV denkst statt in Plattformkennzahlen, ist das hier dein Standard. Wenn nicht, ist es die falsche Stelle.

Wir suchen jemanden, der den kompletten Funnel von der Ad über das Offer und die Landingpage bis zum Kauf als ein System versteht, systematisch testet und Budget dorthin bringt, wo es profitables Wachstum erzeugt – auch wenn das auf Plattformebene erstmal unbequem aussieht.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Media Buying auf Wachstum steuern: Du verantwortest unsere Paid-Social-Konten eigenständig – Budget, Kampagnensetup, Adsets, Creatives einbuchen. Du skalierst, solange die Unit Economics tragen, und skalierst nicht, um Plattformmetriken zu schonen.
  • Full-Funnel-Diagnose: Du analysierst regelmäßig den gesamten Weg von Ad über Offer und Landingpage bis zur Conversion, findest den größten Engpass und priorisierst genau dort.
  • Creative Testing & Creative Diversity: Du entwickelst Testhypothesen, bewertest Creative-Performance und sorgst dafür, dass das Konto nicht von zwei Winning Ads abhängt: verschiedene Angles, Formate, Creator und Hooks parallel im Test, damit Skalierung nicht an Creative Fatigue scheitert. Learnings gehen konkret und datenbasiert an Creative Strategist und Copywriting zurück.
  • Offer- und Landingpage-Tests koordinieren: Du priorisierst den Test-Backlog für Bundles, Preislogik, Value Stack, Message-Match und Landingpage-Struktur, briefst die Fachteams, wertest aus und rollst Gewinner aus.
  • Steuerung nach Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit: Deine Entscheidungsgrundlage sind Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und CAC im Verhältnis zum Kundenwert – nicht der ROAS einer einzelnen Kampagne.
  • Attribution & Datenqualität: Du liest Performance nicht aus dem Ads Manager, sondern aus unserem Attributionsmodell. Du weißt, wo Plattform-Attribution und Realität auseinanderlaufen, sorgst für saubere Datenerfassung und klärst Auffälligkeiten früh mit IT.
  • Struktur & Reporting: Einheitliche Naming Convention, nachvollziehbare Account-Struktur, feste Reporting- und Review-Routinen für Wachstum, Budget und Learnings.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying für Meta Ads im D2C-Kontext – du hast eigenverantwortlich Budgets gesteuert und ein Konto profitabel wachsen lassen, nicht nur effizient gehalten.
  • Du kannst erklären, warum ein Konto mit ROAS 1,0 und wachsendem Neukundenstamm mehr wert ist als eines mit ROAS 4 und stagnierendem Umsatz – und du hast das schon einmal jemandem erklären müssen.
  • Du denkst in Funnels und Kohorten: Du weißt, dass ein schlechter Neukunden-CAC auch am Offer oder an der Landingpage liegen kann, und dass der Wert eines Neukunden erst nach dem ersten Kauf entsteht.
  • Testgetrieben: Du setzt Tests mit klarer Hypothese, Erfolgskriterium und Auswertungslogik auf und dokumentierst, was du lernst.
  • Sicher in Datenanalyse und Attribution – du hast mit Attributionstools jenseits des Ads Managers gearbeitet, kennst die Grenzen von Plattform-Attribution und Tracking-Setups (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs) und erkennst, wenn Daten nicht stimmen.
  • Du kennst gängige DR-Mechaniken (Hook–Problem–Solution, Value Stack, Social Proof, Scarcity) und kannst beurteilen, warum ein Creative oder Offer performt.
  • Du weißt, dass Creative Diversity kein Kreativ-Nice-to-have ist, sondern die Voraussetzung dafür, dass ein Konto skaliert – und planst deinen Testing-Mix entsprechend.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Creative-, Copy- und Web-Teams zusammen – als Taktgeber mit klaren Briefings, nicht als Einzelkämpfer.
  • AI-Tools für Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung und Creative-Analyse nutzt du bereits
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Supplement- oder Health-Brands.

🛠 So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Du bekommst volle Verantwortung für die Paid-Social-Konten und ein Team, das zusammen mit dir Creatives, Copy, Landingpages und Tracking bearbeitet – du priorisierst, was gerade am Wichtigsten ist.
  • Du steuerst mit denselben Zahlen wie die Geschäftsführung: CM3, aMER, MER, Neukunden, Kundenwert. Kein separates „Marketing-Dashboard", das schöner aussieht als die Realität.
  • Wir arbeiten mit Notion für Prozesse, Slack fürs Team und einem eigenen Attributionsstack, in den wir laufend investieren – du steuerst nach diesen Zahlen, nicht nach Meta's Zahlen.
  • Rollen sind bei uns klar definiert: Objective, Job Results, KPIs. Du weißt, wofür du verantwortlich bist – und was nicht.
  • Entscheidungen fallen auf Basis von Daten. Wenn die Daten fehlen, holen wir sie, bevor wir raten.

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine Marke mit klarer Positionierung und Produkten, perfekt für unsere Zielgruppe – und eine Organisation, die Paid Social als Wachstumsmotor denkt, nicht als Kostenstelle.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, echtes Mandat über Budget und Testing.
  • Regelmäßige Performance-Reviews und Learnings – wir skalieren, was funktioniert, und dokumentieren, warum.
  • Remote-Only mit klaren Prozessen und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Die Möglichkeit, das Performance-Marketing-System einer wachsenden Health-Brand von Grund auf mitzubauen – und mit ihr zu wachsen.

Let's grow it!

Du denkst in Full-Funnel, Neukunden, Deckungsbeiträgen und hast den den CLV im Blick?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei konkreten Beispielen, in denen du Meta Ads mit Direct Response Mechaniken zum Wachstum geführt hast und einem kurzen Statement, warum du in unser Team gehörst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

title: Social Media Managerin / Content Creatorin (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst nicht nur Social Media managen, sondern selbst das Gesicht einer Marke werden?

BuddySIM macht mobiles Internet auf Reisen einfach. Mit unseren eSIMs können Reisende in über 190 Ländern direkt online gehen: 100% ohne Roaming-Stress, SIM-Kartenwechsel oder komplizierte Tarife.

Jetzt wollen wir unsere Marke auf Social Media auf das nächste Level bringen. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, vor der Kamera zu stehen, Menschen anzusprechen und gemeinsam mit uns Content zu entwickeln, der auffällt.

Du wirst eines der Gesichter von BuddySIM auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts und weiteren Plattformen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und repräsentierst BuddySIM auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Formate, Reels, TikToks und wiederkehrende Content-Serien.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und führst beispielsweise spontane Interviews, Straßenumfragen oder Reise-Challenges durch.

  • Du beobachtest Trends und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Sounds und Themen Potenzial haben.

  • Du entwickelst Ideen, Hooks, Storylines und Skripte.

  • Du produzierst authentischen Content von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Video.

  • Du begleitest Events, Reisen, Kooperationen oder Aktionen mit der Kamera.

  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine wiedererkennbare Social-Media-Persönlichkeit für BuddySIM auf.

  • Du analysierst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du managed Kooperationen mit anderen Creatoren:innen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Du bist kommunikativ, spontan und kannst Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen.

Außerdem wäre ideal, wenn du:

  • dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und authentisch auftreten kannst,

  • offen und selbstbewusst auf fremde Menschen zugehst,

  • TikTok, Instagram und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends wirklich verstehst,

  • ein gutes Gespür für Humor, Storytelling und interessante Hooks hast,

  • kreative Ideen nicht nur vorschlägst, sondern auch direkt umsetzen möchtest,

  • eigenständig arbeiten und Verantwortung für eigene Formate übernehmen kannst,

  • grundlegende Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt mitbringst,

  • Lust auf Reisen und internationale Themen hast,

  • sehr gutes Deutsch sprichst; Englisch ist ein Plus.

Ein klassischer Lebenslauf oder ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns deutlich weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und dein Gefühl für Social Media.

Was dich bei BuddySIM erwartet

BuddySIM ist ein wachsendes Travel-Tech-Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Wir wollen keine austauschbare Corporate-Kommunikation produzieren, sondern Social Media machen, das Menschen tatsächlich anschauen möchten.

Bei uns bekommst du:

  • sehr viel kreativen Freiraum,

  • die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate von Grund auf aufzubauen,

  • kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung,

  • direkten Austausch mit dem Gründerteam,

  • moderne Tools und Equipment für deine Content-Produktion,

  • ein junges, dynamisches Umfeld,

  • die Möglichkeit, bei Reisen, Events und besonderen Aktionen dabei zu sein,

  • und vor allem die Chance, eine sichtbare Persönlichkeit unserer Marke zu werden.

Wer perfekt zu uns passt

Vielleicht produzierst du bereits selbst TikToks oder Reels.

Vielleicht bist du die Person in deinem Freundeskreis, die problemlos mit jedem ins Gespräch kommt.

Vielleicht hast du bisher noch nie professionell Social Media gemacht, weißt aber ganz genau, warum manche Videos Millionen Views bekommen und andere niemanden interessieren.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Interesse?

Dann schick uns keinen Roman.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und gerne direkt ein kurzes Video, in dem du dich vorstellst.

Bonus: Schick uns eine Idee für ein TikTok oder Reel, das du für BuddySIM drehen würdest.

title: Vice President (m/f/d) Equity Rebalancing
description:
Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Job Overview

Are you passionate about capital markets, index investing, and client-facing investment solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, international environment? We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial markets and quantitative investment strategies with excellent communication and relationship-management skills, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients and stakeholders across global markets.

Your Tasks

  • Manage and oversee a diverse portfolio of quantitative equity indices, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all rebalancing activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the underlying investment strategies and client objectives.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for an international client base, including leading investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and trading desks, acting as a trusted advisor on index methodologies, rebalancing outcomes, and quantitative investment strategies.
  • Lead and coordinate the resolution of client inquiries, escalations, and complex index-related issues, delivering clear, actionable guidance and ensuring a high standard of client service.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and service quality across index management and client support processes.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data, Engineering, and Product, to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery and the successful implementation of client requirements.

Your Profile

  • Academic degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Mathematics, or Engineering.
  • At least 6 years of experience in equity markets execution, portfolio management, index management, or in a similar process-driven financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of equity markets, ETFs, index construction, or systematic investment strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership, able to operate independently and manage operational responsibility across multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to handle time-sensitive operational workflows.
  • Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset and intercultural competence.
  • Python skills are an asset.
  • Fluency in English.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience innovation and excellence in FinTech.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in a flat-hierarchy, startup-like environment.
  • Vacation & Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a market-competitive salary, job ticket, gym membership, and access to Corporate Benefits.
  • Employer Pension Contribution: Benefit from the occupational pension scheme (bAV).
  • Professional Development & Certifications: Grow personally and professionally, with support for certifications and training opportunities.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in networking and team engagement events.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a hybrid work model in a diverse and dynamic environment.

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.
You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.

Who We Want

7+ years of finance experience.
You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Closing and audit expertise.
You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements.

Expert financial modelling.
You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.

Forecasting.
You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

Business partner.
You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented.

Experience with investors and the board.
You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side.
Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities.

Appetite for automation.
You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly.

Strong communicator.
You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal.

Who We Don't Want

Manages the status quo.
You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further.

Reports instead of advising.
You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent.

Treats the model as personal property.
You build something only you can operate with undocumented logic and manual overrides nobody else can follow. Uncomfortable in front of investors.

Looking for predictability.
You need stable priorities and permanently fixed responsibilities.

Your Day To Day

Financial Model & Steering (~30%)

  • You own and maintain our driver-based financial model documented, operable by others, and reconciled to actuals every month
  • You own forecasting, budgeting, liquidity and runway planning, and the management of cash conversion
  • You own headcount planning together with the founders, People and team leads
  • You evaluate business cases for new products, markets and pricing models, and act as a sparring partner to the founders on strategic decisions

Accounting, Tax & Audit (~30%)

  • You own bookkeeping and monthly, quarterly and annual closings under HGB, with clean revenue recognition and accruals
  • You coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors end to end, through to completed financial statements
  • You manage the relationship with our tax advisors and ensure tax obligations are met
  • You own AR, AP and payment processes, and a cost centre structure that scales with the company

KPIs & Business Partnering (~20%)

  • You define and monitor the metrics each team steers by - engagement, conversion, retention - as inputs to the model rather than a separate reporting exercise
  • You sit in the business reviews, translate numbers into concrete recommendations, and follow up on execution
  • You deliver month-end variance analysis and management reporting as a clear, action-oriented narrative rather than a data dump
  • You analyse revenue, margin and cost development at customer, product and channel level

Funding & Investor Relations (~20%)

  • You build and continuously maintain our data room so we're due-diligence-ready at any time
  • You lead the financial due diligence on our side and support the next funding round end to end
  • You own investor reporting and communication on a monthly and quarterly cadence, as well as the board reporting packages
  • You maintain relationships with investors, banks and financing partners

Stakeholders

Founders & Leadership Team: your most important counterpart day-to-day, from annual planning to ongoing prioritisation and the most consequential financial decisions

Team Leads across Sales, Marketing, Product & Customer Success: for KPI definition, budget ownership and business reviews

Board & Investors: for monthly and quarterly reporting, board meetings and funding rounds

External Partners: tax advisors, auditors, banks and financing partners

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

title: (Senior) Account Manager
description:
Your Impact

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

Expanding within the customer base is one of Tacto's biggest growth levers, and we're building it out for the long term. Most mature B2B companies generate 50%+ of their revenue from existing customers - we want to capture more of that potential, and we're strengthening the team to get there. As Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind our expansion motion: identifying and closing upsells, cross-sells, and strategic price increases across our customer base, and helping build and sharpen the playbook as we scale it. You'll work between Sales, Customer Value, and Product, spotting growth opportunities and turning them into revenue. This is your chance to build and grow a crucial commercial function at one of Europe's fastest growing industrial AI companies.

Your Tasks

  • Own deals end-to-end: Identify opportunities, build business cases, run negotiations, close deals. Manage contracts and pricing logic.

  • Master account intelligence: Read customer dynamics, map stakeholders, understand politics. Know when to drive expansion yourself vs. when to bring in AEs or Customer Value. Identify perfect timing for upsells.

  • Coordinate across functions: Coordinate with Sales (pipeline), Customer Success (value-delivery), Product (what to sell), and Finance (forecasting) to drive expansion deals

  • Own forecasting and planning: Build accurate expansion forecasts. Coordinate deal timelines. Keep the business informed and on track.

  • Translate roadmap into revenue: Work with Product and Marketing to turn new modules into concrete expansion conversations with the right customers at the right time.

  • Help building the function as it scales: Turn what you learn into reusable process, qualification criteria, pricing guardrails, forecasting templates, rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value. Where the playbook doesn't exist yet, you help writing it

Your Profile

We're looking for someone who can build, close, and scale. Here's what typically works:

  • 2-4 years in high-performance environments: A proven track record of hitting, and significantly overachieving, quarterly or yearly commercial targets, in account management, sales, or a customer success role with a real commercial component.

  • Proven commercial track record in B2B SaaS companies.

  • Extremely smart and driven – you connect dots quickly, learn fast, and push hard to win

  • Excellent stakeholder management – you navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior buyers (Heads of Procurement, C-Level), and align internal teams

  • Negotiation toughness – you hold your ground in price discussions without burning bridges

  • Process-oriented – you own details: contracts, terms, renewal dates, forecasting

  • Genuine interest in industrial procurement – you want to understand how manufacturing companies work and speak their language

  • Native German + fluent English

Why This Role is Awesome

This is the first dedicated Account Manager seat at Tacto. Some first structures exist, but most of the function is still yours to build: the quota model, the rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value, the process itself. Get this right, and expansion becomes Tacto's biggest new revenue lever within two to three years, that's the scale of upside on the table. Do it well for the first 12 to 18 months, and you define your next step: a bigger book of accounts, leading the function as it grows into a full team, or a move into Sales or Customer Value leadership.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not customer support with a sales quota bolted on. You'll be measured on revenue, not on being liked, and some weeks that means pushing a commercial conversation the customer wasn't asking for.

  • This is not a mature, handed-to-you playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, your own forecast discipline, and parts of the process itself.

  • Prove you can turn module adoption into signed expansion revenue, and we'll back you owning a bigger book, leading the function, or moving into Sales or CV leadership next.

Why Tacto

  • We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. The large majority of our Leadership Team was promoted internally, you deliver impact and the sky is the limit at Tacto.

  • Backed to win big. We're Sequoia and Index Ventures-funded, with more than €50M raised. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Get a glimpse here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

title: (Junior) Energy Data Scientist – Energiedaten & Automatisierung (MSB) (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich

  • Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen)

  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft / Marktkommunikation (MaKo, Messstellenbetrieb, GGV/Mieterstrom, Bilanzierung) - oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich schnell tief einzuarbeiten.

  • Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt

  • Eigenverantwortung und Ownership-Mentalität: du übernimmst einen Bereich, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten; und strebst danach, dein volles Potenzial in diesem Bereich zu entfalten

  • Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

 

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren. Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit.

1. Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents

  • Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen

title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run.

Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions.

That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale.

We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us.

Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation. You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here.

This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed: high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work.

This is not a role for someone who wants to select the next six-figure laboratory automation system from a catalogue. We want someone who looks at a €500,000 solution and asks: Why does this cost €500,000? What problem are we actually solving? And could we achieve the same outcome - or a better one - for a fraction of the cost and at 10x the scale?

Sometimes the answer will be an established lab instrument. Sometimes it will be an industrial robot, a €50 sensor, a 3D-printed part, and some clever engineering.

Your opportunity is to help us completely rethink how lab automation is done and build the infrastructure that makes biological R&D dramatically faster and cheaper.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own lab automation at Differential Bio end-to-end, from creating individual components to developing complete new automated fermentation systems, including technical decisions, experimentation, suppliers, and budget.

  • Drive our ambition to dramatically increase experimental density while reducing the cost per experiment and cost per insight.

  • Translate wet-lab workflows into reliable, scalable automation together with our scientists, software engineers, and ML engineers.

  • Make pragmatic build vs. buy vs. modify decisions instead of defaulting to expensive, closed laboratory automation platforms.

  • Prototype and build yourself: fermentation pods and small bioreactors, using 3D printing & our workshop.

  • Evaluate and integrate robots, liquid handling systems, and emerging automation technologies, working directly with manufacturers to adapt or co-develop around our requirements.

  • Continuously improve reliability, throughput, maintainability, and cost as our automation platform scales.

Qualifications:

We care more about how you solve engineering problems than about a specific degree or career path.

You should:

  • Have evidence of excellence: 4+ years of experience in lab automation, robotics, or other automation projects involving real hardware - or an equivalent track record of serious hobby projects where you have built, modified, automated, and debugged physical systems yourself.

  • Be a tinkerer: someone who enjoys opening the box, understanding how something works, modifying it, and building something better when necessary.

  • Be comfortable with robotics, sensors, actuators, mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, or related technologies.

  • Be able to move quickly between disciplines and collaborate with wet-lab scientists, automation specialists, software engineers, and ML engineers.

  • Be comfortable with ambiguity and high autonomy. We define outcomes; you have substantial freedom to determine how to achieve them.

  • Combine creative engineering with a strong focus on reliability and repeatability.

Experience with laboratory automation, bioreactors, liquid handling, CAD, 3D printing, Python, PLCs, machine vision, or industrial automation is a plus - but not a requirement.

This is a demanding job. The problems are hard, the ownership is real, and there will not always be a playbook to follow. We are looking for someone who enjoys that responsibility rather than avoids it. We want to see the fire in you: the curiosity, energy, and determination to keep digging until something works.

Benefits:

  • Build something fundamentally new: Help move lab automation away from boutique, over-engineered systems toward high-density biological data factories.

  • High ownership: Own our lab automation stack, technical direction, suppliers, and significant parts of the automation budget.

  • Real freedom to build: We have 3D printers, workshop capabilities, testing space, and the budget to buy robots and hardware when experimentation requires it.

  • Direct impact: Work closely with our founder and CTO and shape one of Differential Bio's core technological advantages.

  • Competitive compensation through salary + stock options.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Rankings & Recommendations (all genders)
description:
Your future team

You'll join Search Intelligence, the team behind Holidu's ranking and recommendation systems. With over 8 million vacation rental properties on the platform, your models will determine which of them our 70+ million annual users discover first — directly shaping search conversion and business results. It's one of the highest-leverage problems in the company — and we're not just maintaining a finished system: we're pushing the boundaries of what search at Holidu can do. You'll work with a large and rich dataset, fast paths from concept to production, and the autonomy to act on your own judgment.

Holidu is an AI-first company, and it shows in how we work: your modelling stays grounded in machine learning and statistics, but you'll have large-scale access to the best AI tools and the freedom to weave them into everything you do — from discovery to implementation to maintenance. Everyone here experiments and shares what works, and we'll count on you to help push how far AI can take us.

This role is based in Munich with two office days/week.

The ranking challenge at Holidu

Ranking at Holidu is already a deep system: a multi-stage pipeline with reinforcement-learning-based cold ranking, contextual re-ranking, and personalized recommendations, plus dedicated cold-start models for new properties with limited behavioral data. And it keeps expanding — we're starting to enrich our models with AI-generated semantic signals that describe what makes each home special, opening the door to smarter ranking and entirely new search experiences.The next generation of it is yours to figure out.

Some of the hard challenges we're tackling: balancing user relevance, conversion probability, and business value in a single ranking. Personalizing for users who are mostly anonymous or first-time visitors. Grid Code Compliance & Functional Control Design

System Integration & Communication Architecture

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents
description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents

Sage AI Labs · Munich · Full-time · [Remote]

About us

Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of.

The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the role

We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them.

You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO.

What you'll own

Our checkout agents. Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic.

Ingestion at scale. Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself.

Search and ranking. Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python

  • You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident

  • You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you

  • You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build

  • You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does

Nice to have

  • Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype

  • Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API

  • Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure

Why this role

Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.

  • ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Informatik, Computer Science oder eines vergleichbaren technischen Fachbereichs

    Live-Entertainment-Technologie
    Spiele eine entscheidende Rolle für globale Marken und gestalte das Fan-Erlebnis neu – von Festivals bis hin zu großen Sport Events. Bei uns bist du Teil des Business of Fun – angetrieben von modernster Technologie, die besondere Momente für Millionen greifbar macht.

    Wir wachsen nachhaltig auf einer profitablen, von Investoren unterstützten Basis mit echtem Product-Market-Fit. Das bedeutet kontinuierliche Investitionen in unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Produkte und unsere langfristige Vision.

    Arbeite mit über 160 engagierten Profis zusammen – darunter Führungskräfte von Google, Slack und Salesforce. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Live-Entertainment-Technologie – Entscheidung für Entscheidung.

    Wir sind ein vielfältiges, leistungsorientiertes Team mit sechs Standorten weltweit. Bei uns zählen Talent und Impact – nicht Hierarchie oder Hintergrund.

    Sifted zählt uns regelmäßig zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Europa. Wir werden angetrieben durch konstantes Lernen, gemeinsame Erfolge und kollektives Wachstum.

    Arbeite Seite an Seite mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe in Tech – von Forbes 30 Under 30-Gründern bis hin zu „Executive of the Year“-Preisträgern. Bei vivenu setzt du neue Standards für die Zukunft der Ticketing-Branche.

title: Data Engineering Lead, Agentic Infrastructure
description:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.

With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

With over 10 million end users and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month — and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.
 
As a Data Engineering Lead, Agentic Infrastructure, you will be the foundational technical leader of our data organization, guiding a dedicated pod of engineers in the future. You will act as the technical authority and central hub for all data initiatives across the company, ensuring a cohesive, secure, and scalable data strategy.
By building this scalable technical foundation, you will pave the way for company-wide AI adoption. As the internal platform matures, your scope will likely expand to drive robust data and AI capabilities directly into our customer-facing products.

As a Data Engineering Lead, Agentic Infrastructure (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:
  • Build the foundation: Design, architect, and build our highly scalable internal data platform and core data warehouse, centralizing data across all internal tools and systems. Ensure that every data initiative goes through your team and aligns with our overarching architecture and scalability standards.
  • Lead & mentor: Provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, and hands-on mentorship to a high-impact team of engineers.
  • Drive company-wide AI adoption: Build the robust, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure required to power our internal AI initiatives, enabling intelligent tooling and automation.
  • Scale for the future: Establish a future-proof technical foundation that initially optimizes internal operations, with a clear roadmap to expand into core product features.
  • Establish operational excellence: Implement data governance, data lineage, observability, and strict quality controls to ensure the data platform is reliable and trusted.

    • What you will need to succeed in this role:
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, building modern data stacks, central data warehouses, and high-throughput data pipelines.
  • A track record of technically leading and elevating small teams while remaining deeply hands-on.
  • Proven ability to design company-wide data architectures and act as the principal technical decision-maker for complex data systems.
  • Strong understanding of how to structure, model, and pipeline data specifically to support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner with internal stakeholders to centralize and streamline all business data requests.
  • Familiarity or hands-on experience with Agentic AI technologies, specifically building infrastructure where autonomous agents and AI models can learn, access data, and execute tasks.
    • Why join vivenu?

    Live Entertainment Tech
    Play a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.

    Sustainable Growth
    We scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.

    Top-tier Team
    Collaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.

    Global DNA
    We’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.

    Fast Growing, in All Aspects
    Sifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.

    Next-Gen Leaders & Insights
    Work alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.

    vivenu Inclusion Statement
    At vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.

title: Risk Manager/in (m/f/d)
description:
Location

Frankfurt am Main

About Us

About AllUnity

AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. Established by DWS, Flow Traders, and Galaxy, AllUnity delivers fully backed, MiCAR-compliant stablecoins (EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU) that provide regulatory certainty and robust reserve backing for secure, frictionless capital movement across markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context.

You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations.

You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Risk Management & Governance

  • Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology
  • Maintain and enhance the risk inventory, including control mapping and documentation standards
  • Assess control design and effectiveness across operational and technology-related processes
  • Monitor KRIs and risk appetite thresholds, including follow-up and escalation where required
  • Support tracking and monitoring of recovery indicators and related governance processes
  • Contribute to material change assessments and structured risk papers for management

2. New Product & Process Risk (NPP)

  • Perform end-to-end risk assessments for new blockchain integrations (e.g., L1/L2 chains, bridge solutions)
  • Assess impact on existing operational processes, governance structures and control frameworks
  • Evaluate smart contract-related risk exposure at a conceptual level (e.g., mint/burn controls, upgradeability, governance mechanisms)
  • Identify operational, ICT, outsourcing and concentration risks arising from new initiatives
  • Support the preparation of clear, decision-ready risk assessments for internal approval committees

3. Technology, ICT & Outsourcing Risk (MiCA / DORA)

  • Support alignment of ICT and outsourcing risk management with MiCA and DORA requirements
  • Evaluate third-party providers (e.g., custody, bridge, oracle and technology providers) from a risk and criticality perspective
  • Assess resilience, dependency, concentration and exit strategy considerations
  • Contribute to operational resilience testing and scenario development
  • Ensure technology and outsourcing risks are consistently reflected in the overall risk profile

4. Digital Asset Risk Structuring

  • Translate technical setups into structured, risk-relevant documentation
  • Identify key risk drivers such as governance risk, third-party dependency and single points of failure
  • Challenge control design constructively and propose practical mitigation measures
  • Support stress scenario development (e.g., bridge exploit, de-pegging, chain halt)

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 4 - 6 years of professional experience in Risk Management, Operational Risk, Internal Audit or Risk Advisory
  • Experience in a regulated financial services environment (e.g., bank, EMI, fintech or comparable institution)
  • Practical exposure to risk assessments, control evaluations and governance processes
  • Experience supporting new product approvals or material change assessments is a strong advantage

Technical & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of risk assessment methodologies (inherent/residual risk, control effectiveness, risk appetite frameworks)
  • Familiarity with blockchain fundamentals (e.g., token issuance, smart contracts, L1/L2 chains, bridge concepts)
  • Understanding of operational and technology risk in digital asset environments
  • Knowledge of MiCA and/or DORA requirements is strongly preferred
  • Awareness of outsourcing and third-party risk principles in regulated institutions

Skills & Working Style

  • Strong analytical and structured thinking
  • Excellent documentation and drafting skills in German & English
  • Proficiency in German is required
  • Ability to translate technical and regulatory topics into clear risk documentation
  • Independent and solution-oriented working style
  • Confidence to challenge constructively while collaborating across functions
  • High attention to detail and ownership mindset

Why You Should Apply

In this role, you will not only monitor risk, you will actively contribute to the development and refinement of the risk framework of a BaFin regulated euro stablecoin institution operating under MiCA and DORA.
You will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of traditional financial risk management and blockchain-based infrastructure, working closely with senior leadership in a highly regulated environment.
This role offers meaningful ownership, regulatory depth and exposure to one of Europe’s most innovative digital financial initiatives.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • 45 EURAU Monthly Employee Allowance
  • 30 Days Paid Vacation
  • Learning & Development Budget
  • Transparent Culture, Open Communication and a driven, collaborative team committed to innovation, professionalism, and excellence.
  • Regular Team Retreats & Offsites
  • Welcome Packages & Company Swag

Ready to Apply?

If you are excited to build a world-class digital workplace and help shape the infrastructure powering the future of finance, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Sales Development Representative (all genders)

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Development Representative, you're not just booking meetings.

You're creating the first impression of Lio. You're opening conversations with the world's largest enterprises and helping procurement leaders understand how AI can transform the way they operate.

  • Capture customer feedback and share insights with Product to help shape future features and improvements

  • Own your pipeline from first touch to handoff and ensure a seamless customer experience

  • Help build and continuously improve Lio's go-to-market playbook

Your Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you:

What's not required

Previous experience in enterprise sales, business development, or SDR roles is not required.

We're much more interested in ambition, curiosity, communication skills, and execution than in having the perfect CV.

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Silicon Valley's most prestigious investor. We're bringing that same ambition, speed, and culture to Munich. This is a unique opportunity to join a company with Silicon Valley DNA while building in Europe.

We work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, working with C-level procurement leaders on large-scale transformation initiatives. Joining Lio today means joining early. The category is still being defined. The playbook is still being written. Everyone at Lio is expected to take ownership, move fast, and help shape not only the business, but also the culture we're building.

If you're excited about building something exceptional, working with world-class customers, and helping shape one of Europe's category defining AI companies, we'd love to hear from you.

Opportunities like this don't come around often. If you're looking for a comfortable 9-to-5, Lio is probably not for you. If you're excited about building something extraordinary, we'd love to talk.
