description:
Staff Product Designer - Agents

Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Coda’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

At Superhuman, we're on a mission to redefine how people communicate and get work done with AI. We're hiring an experienced Staff Product Designer to join the Agents team in Berlin.

We're designing entirely new interaction patterns around how AI and humans work together through agents, through writing, from fixing your grammar to helping you schedule meetings. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley.

In This Role:

  • Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do.

  • Work with designers you'll learn from. The team spans San Francisco and Europe, with people who've come from some of the best product companies around. If you're looking for a design-focused environment with a lot of people to learn from, you'll get that here.

  • Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine.

  • Shape design strategy. Bring user insights, prototype ideas, and help build a longer-term view of where the Agents roadmap goes.

  • Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role.

  • Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role.

  • A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping.

  • You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words.

  • Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making.

  • Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll join Wonderland, Jimdo's internal Platform Engineering team responsible for the cloud platform that every engineering team builds on. You'll work on a modern stack including AWS (EKS), Kubernetes, Terraform, Cloudflare, Vault, Grafana Cloud and GitHub Actions, helping evolve the platform while improving reliability, developer experience and operational efficiency. As part of a small, senior team, you'll have broad ownership, influence platform strategy, and build solutions that have an impact across every product team at Jimdo.

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps deployment workflows.

  • Enhance observability through monitoring, logging, alerting and incident management.

  • Implement platform security, secrets management and infrastructure compliance.

  • Partner with engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and developer experience.

  • Contribute production-quality code, primarily in Go, to platform tooling and automation.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description:
Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world.

Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight.

For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work.

More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers.

We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims.

This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on.

If you want unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform, Matomo is worth a serious look.


Why this role matters

Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features. 

It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. 

We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. 

As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. 

You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. 


What you’ll own

You'll own problems, not just code. 

This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. 

You'll own work from problem to outcome: 

  • Understand the problem before committing to a solution.  

  • Help shape priorities, not just implement them.  

  • Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you.  

  • Ship incrementally and learn from real usage.  

  • Measure outcomes and iterate.  

  • Use AI throughout your workflow. 

    • For senior: You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. 

    For intermediate: You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs. 

    What the work looks like 

    You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. 

    Examples include: 

    • Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase.  

    • Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo.  

    • Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on.  

    • Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases.  

    • Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations.  

    • Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. 

    • Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring. 

    • Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards.

    • Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use.  

    • Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. 


How we work

We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size.

That means we optimise for impact.

We value:

  • Customer problems over technical elegance.

  • Shipping over endless planning.

  • Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Ownership over handoffs.

  • Iteration over perfection.

  • Clear writing over excessive meetings.

  • Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture.

  • AI where it helps us move faster.

  • Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right.

    • We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it.

    At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary.


What we’re looking for

For senior: You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. 

For intermediate: You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. 

You enjoy building products

You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone.

You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses.

You naturally ask:

  • What problem are we solving?

  • Who has this problem?

  • Is this the simplest useful solution?

  • How will we know this made things better?

  • What should we do if the data shows we were wrong?

    • You are comfortable with complex, mature systems

    You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository.

    You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites.

    You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified.

    You are comfortable across the stack

    You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.

    Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.

    You use AI as part of how you work

    We make heavy use of AI-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow.

    You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality.

    AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and customer impact.


You’ll probably thrive here if

  • You prefer owning outcomes over receiving detailed tickets.

  • You enjoy solving difficult problems in existing systems as well as building new functionality.

  • You can quickly diagnose complex or intermittent bugs.

  • You can move from customer feedback or operational evidence to investigation, product decision and implementation.

  • You care about reliability, performance and data accuracy, not only visible feature work.

  • You can improve a mature codebase without assuming it needs to be rewritten.

  • You use AI tools heavily and are actively improving how you work with them.

  • You are pragmatic: you can make a focused improvement now while recognising when a deeper change is needed.

  • You can explain technical and product trade-offs clearly.

  • You enjoy working across product, engineering, UX, data and customer feedback.

  • You like small teams where your decisions and output visibly matter.

    • below for intermediate only:

    • You're excited to take on increasingly ambiguous problems.  

      • You want to grow beyond implementation into shaping products and technical decisions. 


You may not enjoy this role if

  • You mainly want to work on new greenfield products.

  • You see maintenance, debugging, reliability or performance work as less valuable than feature development.

  • You want a product manager to define most requirements before you start.

  • You are uncomfortable investigating problems where the cause is initially unclear.

  • You prefer replacing existing systems rather than understanding why they work as they do.

  • You measure success mainly by code quality rather than user or business impact.

  • You are uncomfortable using AI as part of your normal engineering workflow.

  • You need a large team, narrow responsibilities, or highly formal processes to be effective.

  • You prefer polishing a solution extensively before showing it to users.

  • You dislike writing proposals, documentation, or product notes.

  • You are uncomfortable balancing speed, backwards compatibility and long-term platform health.


Remote work

Matomo is a remote company.

We work mostly asynchronously and rely heavily on clear written communication. You should be comfortable working independently, documenting your thinking, and collaborating without needing constant meetings.


Location
100% remote — Germany, UK or Ireland only.

Hiring process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, build, communicate, and use AI in realistic product engineering work.

The process usually includes: Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Technical skills interview → Final technical interview.

We do not expect unpaid multi-day projects. We want to understand how you approach ambiguous problems, make trade-offs, use AI, and ship useful product improvements.


Diversity and Inclusion
InnoCraft (trading as Matomo) values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.

Interested?
If you care about solving meaningful customer problems, improving software that people depend on, working with high ownership, and making privacy-friendly analytics more secure, reliable, accurate and useful, we’d like to hear from you.

Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027. What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone).

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!

Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads. You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki.

About the role

The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

Your daily work will include

  • Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data. 
  • Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github).
  • Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic.
  • Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation.
  • Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation.
  • Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members.

Our humble expectations 

  • 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer.
  • Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards.
  • Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc.
  • Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets.
  • Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

title: (Senior) CRM Manager (f/m/d)
description:

Bei Juit ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden, sich jeden Tag gesund zu ernähren, indem wir von Köchen und Köchinnen zubereitete Mahlzeiten direkt nach Hause liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, die Nummer 1 unter den Marken für gesunde Mahlzeiten in Deutschland zu werden, indem wir unseren Kunden das beste Online-, Essens- und Liefererlebnis bieten.

Unsere Kund*innen sind bereits überzeugt - 4,8 von 5 Sternen bei über 20k Bewertungen sprechen für sich.

Als (Senior) CRM Manager (m/w/d) bist du Teil des Marketing-Teams und wirst zur Schnittstelle zu unserer Community. Dabei förderst du den stetigen Kontakt, gibst Inspiration und setzt Impulse um die enge Bindung zu unseren Kund*innen aufrechtzuerhalten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und optimierst kontinuierlich unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie.

  • Du verantwortest die CRM-Roadmap und treibst unsere Personalisierungs- und Segmentierungsstrategie voran.
  • Du entwickelst neue CRM-Initiativen, um die Retention, den Customer Lifetime Value und die Loyalität zu steigern.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Marketing, Product, BI und Tech) zusammen, um die Customer Experience stetig zu optimieren.
  • Du etablierst eine datengetriebene Test- und Experimentierkultur im CRM.

Deine Stärken

  • Du arbeitest selbstgesteuert, bist extrem proaktiv und besitzt die Lösungskompetenz, um Herausforderungen selbstbewusst zu meistern.
  • Du denkst datengetrieben, kannst Analysen entwerfen und diese Erkenntnisse direkt in Business Decisions sowie die Optimierung von Kampagnen umwandeln.

  • Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sind hervorragend.
  • Du verstehst es, Dich nahtlos mit anderen Teams abzustimmen, um die CRM-Strategie und alle Marketingaktivitäten zu optimieren.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Als Sales Development Representative bist du der Erstkontakt für unsere potenziellen Neukunden und legst damit den Grundstein für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit. In dieser Vertriebsrolle entscheidet deine Einschätzung bezüglich des Potentials eines Interessenten maßgeblich über den Teamerfolg.

  • Prospecting: Gezielte Suche nach potenziellen Kunden und Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Qualifizierung: Kontaktaufnahme mit Leads und Bewertung ihrer Bedürfnisse, um sie als qualifizierte Verkaufsmöglichkeiten einzustufen.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen im Bereich Akquise und Verkauf, optimalerweise im B2B Sales

  • Du zeigst Zielstrebigkeit und den Ehrgeizig, um selbst für deinen persönlichen Erfolg verantwortlich zu sein

  • Du hast eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Überzeugungskraft, sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich

  • Du bringst gerne deine eigenen Ideen ein, um dich und dein Team auf das nächste Level zu bringen

  • Du hast den Wunsch, eine Karriere im Vertrieb auf- bzw. auszubauen

  • Gestalte ein Produkt, das reale Probleme in der Baubranche löst.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.

That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.

We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

What you will be working on

  • Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

  • Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

  • Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

  • Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you.

  • Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR.

What we're looking for

  • Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong.

  • Evidence of analytics. You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered.

  • Taste. You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made.

  • Real code shipped to real users. React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it.

  • AI as leverage, not as identity. We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made.

  • German and English. Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one.

How we work

In the office, Munich, five days a week. We build in the same room — decisions happen at desks, not in tickets. Relocation support if you're not here yet.

High pace, steep learning curve. Most of the team is here well past six. That's not a policy or a number we track, it's what building something this size with sixteen people currently takes, and it's a phase, not a permanent state. If you're optimising for predictable hours right now, this is the wrong role, and that's a completely reasonable thing to be optimising for.

This is not the role if you want specs handed to you, you separate "my design work" from "my engineering work," you need a design system before you can start, or your best work needs a slide to explain it.

About the Founders

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean, the co-founders of Mercura.

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible.

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI.
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences.

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations.
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

title: Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution


The Role

We are seeking an experienced Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the development, integration, optimization, and manufacturing implementation of graphene transfer, lamination, patterning, and related wet processes for next-generation IGP™ devices.

This role combines graphene process development, equipment integration, wafer handling/lamination, wet processing, and manufacturing engineering. You will work across the technology lifecycle, from R&D and process development through equipment qualification, fab startup, production ramp-up, and sustained manufacturing.

You will work closely with Process Integration, Device, Equipment, Facilities, Metrology, Manufacturing, R&D, and external technology partners to develop reliable, scalable, and manufacturable graphene solutions.

To join our team, you should be excited to

Graphene Process Development

  • Lead the development and optimization of graphene transfer, lamination, handling, patterning, and related wet processes for IGP™ applications.

  • Develop scalable graphene process flows from R&D through qualification and manufacturing ramp-up.

  • Develop and optimize wet processes, including cleaning, surface preparation, chemical treatment, resist processing, graphene patterning, and post-process cleaning.

  • Establish process windows to achieve the required graphene quality, adhesion, uniformity, cleanliness, pattern fidelity, and device performance.

  • Evaluate and qualify new materials, chemicals, tapes, carriers, processes, and technologies for graphene integration.

  • Drive process innovation and solve complex graphene integration and manufacturing challenges.

Equipment Development & Integration

  • Lead the development and integration of graphene transfer, lamination, wafer mounting, tape application, wafer handling, and wet-process equipment.

  • Define equipment requirements, specifications, process capabilities, and automation requirements.

  • Support equipment selection, design/modification, installation, commissioning, FAT/SAT, qualification, and production release.

  • Work with equipment suppliers and OEMs to develop and modify equipment for Black Semiconductor’s graphene processes.

  • Optimize equipment configuration, recipes, wafer handling, vacuum, motion, tension control, and automation.

  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues and lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive DOE, process characterization, data analysis, SPC, and process monitoring to improve yield, quality, reliability, and productivity.

  • Establish and maintain PORs, process specifications, equipment specifications, recipes, process windows, and control plans.

  • Analyze metrology and inspection data to identify process trends, defects, and improvement opportunities.

  • Support fab startup, process/equipment qualification, production readiness, yield improvement, throughput, cycle-time improvement, and production ramp-up.

  • Develop manufacturing procedures, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and qualification documentation.

  • Lead continuous improvement activities focused on yield, quality, throughput, equipment reliability, safety, and cost of ownership.

Collaboration & Technology Transfer

  • Collaborate with Process Integration, Device, Equipment, Facilities, Metrology, Manufacturing, Quality, and R&D teams to solve technical challenges.

  • Work with chemical, material, equipment, and technology suppliers to evaluate and qualify new solutions.

  • Lead technical discussions with external partners, universities, research institutes, and equipment suppliers.

  • Transfer process knowledge from R&D into manufacturing in a controlled and scalable manner.

  • Support technician and engineer training for graphene processes and equipment.

Your Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • 3+ years of semiconductor, advanced materials, advanced packaging, wafer processing, or related manufacturing experience.

  • Strong experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Graphene or 2D-material processing and integration

    • Graphene transfer and handling

    • Wafer lamination, mounting, or tape application

    • Thin-wafer handling

    • Wet and chemical processing

    • Advanced packaging or wafer-level manufacturing

    • Semiconductor equipment development and integration

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the
EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the
core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its
lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team. The center of this role
is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and
the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the
OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS.


What will your job look like
  • Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent,
    operational platform under embedded constraints.
  • Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as
    first-class distribution components.
  • Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and
    core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.
  • Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment
    (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
  • Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and
    SDK/runtime issues on the target.
  • Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up
    through a fully operational stack.
  • Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and
    related target hardware.

    • All you need is:
  • Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.  
  • 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or
    distribution work.
  • Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the
    kernel.
  • Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init
    systems) and root filesystem layout.
  • Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or
    Linux-from-scratch).
  • Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and
    userspace components into a custom image.
  • Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.
  • Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and
    environment setup.

    • Nice to have:
  • Background in Automotive Software .\
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute
    libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).
  • Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.
    • Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

This is a high-impact engineering role focused on building the platforms, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that help engineering teams move faster without compromising quality.
You’ll own complex technical initiatives end to end, from architecture and implementation through production operations and long-term evolution.
Your work will shape developer productivity, CI/CD, testing, observability, engineering insights, and AI-assisted development practices across the organization.
You’ll operate with significant autonomy, leading multi-quarter projects and turning complex technical challenges into measurable outcomes.
You’ll work closely with engineering leadership to influence technical strategy, challenge assumptions, and define the roadmap for your area.
The role combines hands-on backend engineering with technical leadership, mentorship, and ownership of systems used by other engineers every day.
It’s an opportunity to have a broad technical footprint while helping define how modern, AI-enabled software engineering teams operate.


Accountabilities
  • Own the architecture, development, deployment, and long-term evolution of developer platform and AI tooling capabilities.
  • Lead multi-quarter technical projects, breaking complex initiatives into clear milestones and delivering measurable improvements iteratively.
  • Build and operate systems covering developer productivity, CI/CD, observability and engineering metrics, code quality automation, testing infrastructure, and AI-assisted development.
  • Lead the adoption and effective use of AI-powered developer tools and capabilities across engineering teams.
  • Define technical direction for your area, anticipating longer-term challenges and developing scalable solutions and engineering capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering leadership on roadmap and technical strategy, providing technical recommendations, challenging requirements where appropriate, and identifying alternative approaches.
  • Mentor engineers through design collaboration, code reviews, technical guidance, and strong engineering practices.
  • Take ownership of the operational health of systems, using data and feedback to guide improvements, maintenance, iteration, and deprecation.
  • Ensure integrations with third-party APIs, SaaS products, and external platforms are reliable, secure, maintainable, and provide a strong developer experience.

    • Requirements:

    • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2–3+ years operating at Senior or Staff level.
    • Strong hands-on experience building and operating developer platforms, developer tooling, CI/CD systems, observability or metrics infrastructure, code quality automation, testing infrastructure, or related engineering systems.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering infrastructure or tooling that measurably improves developer velocity, productivity, quality, or reduces engineering complexity.
    • Previous experience leading the adoption of AI-powered developer tools or capabilities across an engineering organization.
    • Experience working within a high-performing engineering environment, such as a scale-up or established technology organization, with a strong understanding of how infrastructure decisions affect developer productivity and product quality.
    • Experience integrating third-party services, APIs, SaaS tools, or external platforms into internal systems, with strong attention to reliability, security, maintainability, and user experience.
    • Strong understanding of how platform and infrastructure investments enable broader product and commercial outcomes.
    • Experience owning significant technical areas end to end, including architecture, implementation, operations, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions, work effectively with leadership, and mentor other engineers.
    • High degree of autonomy, sound technical judgment, and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs while knowing when to involve stakeholders or escalate decisions.

      • Benefits:

      • Starting base salary of €130,000 / £130,000 / CHF 130,000, depending on location and applicable currency.
      • Equity in the form of RSUs.
      • Full-time employment; contractor arrangements are not available.

      • Collaboration with highly experienced engineering teams working at the forefront of AI-enabled software development.
      • Visa sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates already located in a UK/EU country who require support; relocation is not provided.

title: Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
description:
Was wir tun

Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden.
Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet.

Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert.
Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen.
Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin


Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln?

Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Java und Quarkus – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig bis ins Angular-Frontend mit TypeScript.

KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes.

  • Du entwickelst robuste Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus – von der Architektur über APIs bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

  • Du arbeitest an der dazugehörigen Angular-Anwendung mit TypeScript und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Backend und Frontend mit.

  • Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow.

  • Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung.

  • Ausgeprägte Praxis in Java und Quarkus sowie gute Kenntnisse in Angular und TypeScript im Frontend.

  • Vertrautheit mit REST-APIs, Datenbanken und ORM.

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, inklusive E2E-Testing.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Coding-Workflows – z. B. mit Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du kannst erklären, welche Prompts, Setups und Guardrails bei dir funktionieren – und wo die Grenzen liegen.

  • Gutes Gespür für Softwarearchitektur, Codequalität und langfristig wartbare Lösungen.

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden zwingend erforderlich.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentationen und internationale Tools.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Hintergrund in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung einer IoT-Plattform

  • Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen, Gerätedaten, Messaging oder technischen Schnittstellen

  • Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-native Development

  • Vertrautheit mit CI/CD, Observability oder Platform Engineering

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Erzähl uns gerne, an welchen Softwarelösungen du bisher gearbeitet hast und wie du KI-gestützte Werkzeuge in deinem Alltag einsetzt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung bei INSIDE M2M

Als Senior Accountant ERP & Digitalisierung gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung moderner Finance Abläufe, treibst gruppenweite ERP Lösungen voran und fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Finance und IT.

🔍 Das bedeutet konkret:

ERP Verantwortung: Modulverantwortung für Finance Prozesse in Microsoft Dynamics 365 für bestehende & zukünftige Gesellschaften der Unternehmensgruppe

title: Qualitätsmanagement & Qualitätssicherung Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Als QM & QS Specialist (m/w/d) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Systeme höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen. Du verantwortest die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems, treibst Verbesserungsmaßnahmen voran und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Hochtemperatur-Wärmepumpen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg normkonform, sicher und zuverlässig entwickelt, gefertigt und ausgeliefert werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, Einkauf, Produktion, Service sowie unseren Lieferanten und Kunden zusammen und fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson für alle qualitätsrelevanten Themen.


Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
  • Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung, Pflege und Überwachung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems nach ISO 9001 einschließlich der Sicherstellung normgerechter Prozesse und Dokumentationen
  • Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung interner sowie externer Audits sowie Koordination von Zertifizierungs- und Überwachungsaudits
  • Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozesses (KVP) einschließlich Dokumentenlenkung, Qualitätskennzahlen und Management-Reporting
  • Funktion als zentrale Ansprechperson für Qualitätssicherungsthemen entlang der gesamten Lieferkette sowie Koordination von Qualitätsaktivitäten mit Herstellern, Lieferanten und externen Partnern
  • Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), End-of-Line-Tests sowie qualitätsrelevanten Prüfungen im internen Test-Center
  • Bearbeitung von Reklamationen, Durchführung von Ursachenanalysen sowie Einleitung und Nachverfolgung nachhaltiger Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen
  • Erstellung, Moderation und Pflege von Prozess- und Design-FMEAs sowie Durchführung von Risikoanalysen für bestehende und neue Produktlinien
  • Unterstützung und Begleitung von CE-Konformitätsbewertungen sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Normen und Richtlinien
  • Qualitätssicherung im Bereich Druckgeräte und Kälteanlagen unter Berücksichtigung der Druckgeräterichtlinie (PED), EN 378 sowie weiterer relevanter Regelwerke
  • Überprüfung technischer Dokumentationen wie P&IDs, Schweißdokumentationen und Fertigungsunterlagen im Hinblick auf Qualitäts- und Normanforderungen
  • Unterstützung bei der elektrischen Validierung von Anlagen und Komponenten nach EN 60204-1 sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsanforderungen
  • Qualifizierung, Entwicklung und Bewertung von Lieferanten sowie Durchführung von Lieferantenaudits und Begleitung von Werksabnahmen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Einkauf, Produktion und Service zur Sicherstellung höchster Qualitätsstandards über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg

    • Dein Profil:
  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement und/oder in der Qualitätssicherung, idealerweise im Maschinen-, Anlagen- oder Sondermaschinenbau
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse relevanter Normen und Regelwerke wie ISO 9001, PED, EN 378, EN 60204-1 sowie der Maschinenrichtlinie
  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Audits sowie im Umgang mit Qualitätsmethoden wie FMEA, 8D, PDCA und Root-Cause-Analysen
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Druckgeräte, Schweißtechnik, Fertigungsprozesse und Lieferantenqualität sind von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen nationalen und internationalen Dienstreisen

  • Ein internationales, kollegiales und unterstützendes Teamumfeld
  • Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungswege

Über Uns

Performance Marketing


• Paid Social campagnes: Je helpt het team bij het beheren, optimaliseren en schalen van onze paid social media-kanalen, met een sterke focus op de META-platformen (Facebook & Instagram).
• Contentcreatie: Je ondersteunt het volledige creatieve proces voor META-ads – van de eerste brainstorm en videoproductie tot de uiteindelijke publicatie.
• Lokalisatie & Vertaling: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen en aanpassen van internationale advertenties en copy naar pakkende, Nederlandstalige ad-creatives.
• On-camera aanwezigheid (Pre): Je vindt het leuk en bent comfortabel om zelf voor de camera te staan voor het maken van authentieke (UGC-style) video-content voor de Nederlandse markt.


THIS IS YOU

Als jij je met passie inzet voor duurzaamheid en supergemotiveerd bent om samen met ons de wereld een stukje schoner te maken, dan vinden wij dat echt geweldig!
Als je daarnaast graag proactief én in teamverband werkt, en je elke kleine en grote uitdaging ziet als een kans om nog beter te worden – dan zijn we nu al een heel klein beetje verliefd op je.
Als je tot slot ook nog beschikt over de volgende vaardigheden en ervaring, dan weten we het bijna zeker: dit zou het begin kunnen zijn van een heel mooi liefdesverhaal!

• Je bent woonachtig in de regio München en bent bereid om op ons kantoor te werken.

• Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, maar bent bovenal een enthousiaste teamplayer.
• Je hebt affiniteit met data, volgt trends op social media op de voet en begrijpt wat een video of ad 'hoofden doet draaien'.
• Pluspunt: Je staat graag voor de camera en vindt het leuk om zelf video's (Reels/TikToks) op te nemen!

THIS IS EVERDROP


Onze missie 💚🌱🌎


We willen de wereld veranderen – samen met jou! De alledaagse producten van everdrop helpen mensen om op een eenvoudige manier hun ecologische voetafdruk in het huishouden te verkleinen. In 2020 zijn we gestart met onze schoonmaaktabs. Sindsdien hebben onze huishoud- en verzorgingsproducten al meer dan 20 miljoen wegwerpplastic flessen en duizenden tonnen aan onnodige CO₂-uitstoot en chemische grondstoffen bespaard.
Sinds 2023 zijn we bovendien een gecertificeerde B Corp. En met jouw hulp willen we everdrop naar een volgend niveau tillen. Sluit je aan bij onze missie en help ons om een duurzame levensstijl zo eenvoudig te maken dat deze de nieuwe standaard in onze samenleving wordt.


Onze Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • Afwisselend, betekenisvol en doelgericht werk

  • Twee betaalde verlofdagen per jaar voor je eigen persoonlijke milieu- of gemeenschapsprojecten (Green & Social Impact Days)

  • Je eigen MacBook zolang je bij everdrop werkt


Onze waarden 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Bij everdrop streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse cultuur waarin iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt. De ambitie om de wereld een stukje beter te maken, vormt een vast onderdeel van hoe we iedere dag werken. Bovenal willen we het bewustzijn voor onze planeet én voor elkaar vergroten.


Een voorbeeld van hoe we dit bewustzijn op de werkvloer stimuleren, zijn onze Power Days. Menstruerende collega's die last hebben van menstruatiepijn kunnen één of meerdere extra betaalde vrije dagen opnemen – zonder vragen of verantwoording af te hoeven leggen.
Daarnaast zijn onze Green & Social Impact Days twee extra betaalde verlofdagen per jaar die je kunt inzetten voor je eigen milieu- of gemeenschapsprojecten.


Ook in ons sollicitatieproces proberen we zo bewust en inclusief mogelijk te werk te gaan.
We behandelen iedereen gelijk, ongeacht afkomst, gender, religie, leeftijd, uiterlijk, taal, cultuur, nationaliteit, burgerlijke staat, seksuele geaardheid of lichamelijke beperking.


We zijn zeker niet perfect – maar we willen iedere dag beter worden en bij elke stap iets nieuws leren. Want dat is waar iedere reis om draait.

description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

  • Jeden Monat fragen Tausende Haushalte bei uns eine Beratung für Solar, Wärmepumpe oder Heartbeat AI an. Bis zur Unterschrift ist es ein ganz schöner Weg: Inside Sales, über 40 Standorte, Kalender, CRM und jede Menge Übergaben per Hand. Mal läuft die Pipeline richtig gut, mal hakt es an mehreren Stellen gleichzeitig
  • Da setzt du an. Du machst diesen Weg schneller, sauberer und messbar, und du baust dafür selbst: Systeme, Prozesse und Auswertungen, die auch dann noch halten, wenn wir weiter wachsen
  • Du wirst Teil unseres kleinen RevOps-Teams in Growth. Wir sind so etwas wie das Schweizer Taschenmesser im Haus: Mal löschen wir Brände, mal bauen wir Dinge, die dauerhaft laufen. Wir sind über die ganze Customer Journey unterwegs und sitzen mit Sales, Marketing und Tech am Tisch, und die wollen nicht immer dasselbe. Wir halten es pragmatisch. Uns interessiert vor allem, ob es fürs Business und für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich was bringt

Was du verantwortest

  • Mehrere Journey Funnel-Stufen und die wichtigsten Kennzahlen liegen bei dir. Du behältst die Hebel im Blick, findest heraus, wo und warum es hakt, baust die Lösung und testest sie an ein, zwei Standorten. Du skalierst funktionierende Lösungen in alle Märkte
  • Je nach Profil arbeitest du mehr in der Breite oder mehr in der Tiefe. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt entweder auf Lead Routing, Scoring, Qualifizierung und unserem Kontakt- und Terminsystem oder auf dem Weg vom qualifizierten Lead zum Angebot.
  • Dazu gehören die Systeme dahinter: die Dashboards, mit denen gesteuert wird, die Prozesse und Automatisierungen, die alles am Laufen halten, und die Daten, auf denen es aufbaut
  • Deine Lösungen baust du selbst, bringst sie in den operativen Betrieb und rollst sie aus. Wo es nötig ist, arbeitest du dabei mit unseren Tech-Teams zusammen

Was du konkret machst

  • Steuerung aufbauen: Looker-Dashboards, Alerts und SLAs, mit denen Vertriebsleitungen in der Zentrale und an den Standorten jede Woche arbeiten
  • Übergaben automatisieren: Routing, Terminvergabe, die Übergabe von Inside Sales an die Standorte und den Umgang mit No-Shows und Dubletten
  • AI-Workflows selbst bauen: Prototypen in Windmill oder n8n, die du gemeinsam mit MarTech und Tech live bringst
  • Für saubere Daten sorgen: Felddefinitionen, Pflichtfelder, regelmäßige Datenpflege und Source-of-Truth-Regeln in unserem CRM (Zoho)
  • Piloten sauber aufsetzen: Hypothese, ein bis zwei Standorte, gemessenes Ergebnis und am Ende die Entscheidung, ob ausgerollt wird
  • Einen Backlog an Optimierungsmaßnahmen aufbauen: Call-Transkripte, Pipeline- und Standortdaten werden zu einer priorisierten Liste, was als Nächstes gebaut wird
  • Teams mitnehmen und enablen: Mit Dokumentation, Trainings und Rollouts sorgst du dafür, dass Standortleitungen, Inside Sales und Vertrieb deine Systeme auch nutzen

Damit arbeitest du unter anderem: Zoho CRM, Looker, Windmill, n8n, Heyflow, Calendly, Aircall, ActiveCampaign, Telli, Google Workspace

Dein Profil

  • Du hast 1-2+ Jahre oder mehr Erfahrung in RevOps, Sales Ops, GTM Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Dort hast du eine Funnel-Kennzahl wirklich verantwortet und nicht nur reported
  • Du weißt, wie ein Sales Funnel funktioniert, von Lead über Qualifizierung, Deal und Angebot bis zum Upsell. Und du weißt, was an jeder Stelle die Conversion und Cycle Time treibt
  • Du hast KPIs, Automatisierungen oder AI-Workflows selbst aufgebaut und live gebracht, etwa mit Windmill, n8n, Make, Python, Claude etc. Und sie werden im Alltag tatsächlich skaliert genutzt
  • Deine Dashboards baust du selbst, in Looker, Power BI, Tableau oder einem ähnlichen Tool. Dass die Daten am Anfang unsauber sind, schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Du kennst dich mit CRM-Systemen aus (Zoho oder ähnliche), vom Datenmodell über Workflows bis zu Integrationen
  • Du arbeitest gern eng mit Tech, Sales und Marketing zusammen und sprichst die Sprache aller drei. Technische Trade-offs übersetzt du in Business-Entscheidungen und kommerzielle Prioritäten in technische Anforderungen, ohne dass jemand vermitteln muss
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift

Das ist ein Plus

  • Du hast schon mit einer Vertriebsorganisation mit Standorten oder Außendienst gearbeitet, nicht nur aus der Zentrale heraus
  • Du hast Lead Management schon praktisch umgesetzt: Scoring, Routing, Nurturing, Terminvergabe etc
  • Du hast erste Agents, z.B. extern Voice AI oder Conversational Agents oder interne Effizienz-Automatisierungen schon live gebracht
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit dem B2C-Geschäft und mit hochpreisigen Produkten, etwa Energie, Solar, Hausmodernisierung oder Automotive

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt & Berlin zu arbeiten und hybrid
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur

Deine Mission

Du willst nicht einfach nur Akten wälzen, sondern die echte Welt der strategischen Management- und IT-Beratung hautnah kennenlernen? Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) in unserem Business Security Consulting Team arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Head of Consultancy DACH zusammen.

Your Mission

As our ICT Outsourcing Manager, you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to improve our third-party management process adding automation and AI supported assessments across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes.

In this role you will:

  • Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful.

  • Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment.

  • Have a solid understanding of how external providers and outsourcing relationships are governed, documented, and monitored from a risk and compliance perspective.

  • Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer.

  • Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned.

  • Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable.

title: Chief Technology Officer | Customer-Centric Business Development | FinTech (w/m/d)
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – Customer-Centric Business Development / FinTech (w/m/d)

Deutschland · Remote-first · 90.000–120.000 € Jahresgehalt

Du verbindest technologische Führung mit unternehmerischem Denken und überzeugst Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Augenhöhe. In dieser Rolle entwickelst du nicht nur die Tech-Strategie eines wachsenden FinTechs weiter: Du identifizierst neue Geschäftschancen, gewinnst C‑Level-Kunden und trägst nachweislich zum kommerziellen Wachstum bei.

Gesucht wird eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit fundierter FinTech- oder Banking-Erfahrung, einem belastbaren Netzwerk in der Branche und praktischer Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, setzt sie hands-on um und machst aus technologischen Möglichkeiten konkrete Kundennutzen und tragfähige Geschäftsmodelle.

Unser Kunde
Ein mittelständisches FinTech‑Unternehmen im Bereich Datenanalyse für Banken, mit 11‑50 Mitarbeitenden und Hauptsitz in Kassel. Das Unternehmen bietet cloud‑basierte Transaction‑Analytics‑Lösungen und positioniert sich als europäischer Vorreiter datengetriebener Geschäftsmodelle. Es kombiniert moderne KI‑Technologien mit einem remote‑first Arbeitsmodell.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Strategische Freiheit: Du formst die Tech‑Vision und bestimmst die Roadmap
  • Hoher Impact: Direkte C‑Level‑Sales und Mitgestaltung neuer Geschäftsmodelle
  • Modernster AI‑Stack: Cloud, APIs, GraphQL, REST und KI‑Kultur bieten eine steile Lernkurve
  • Remote‑First: Flexibles Arbeiten aus Deutschland, 5 Home‑Office‑Tage und Workation‑Option
  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket: 90‑120 k € Fix + Jahresbonus, 30 Tage Urlaub inkl. 24./31.12. frei.

Aufgaben

  • Technologie und Strategie gestalten: Eine zukunftsorientierte Tech-Vision entwickeln und in kundenrelevante Produkte und eine klare Roadmap übersetzen.
  • Wachstum vorantreiben: Neue Geschäftschancen und Anwendungsfelder identifizieren und daraus konkrete Angebote und Geschäftsmodelle entwickeln.
  • C‑Level-Kunden gewinnen: Technische Lösungen und ihren geschäftlichen Nutzen überzeugend auf Entscheider-Ebene präsentieren und Verkaufsprozesse aktiv voranbringen.
  • Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Dein Netzwerk in Banking und FinTech nutzen und strategische Partnerschaften sowie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen entwickeln.
  • Technologie verantworten: Cloud-, API- und KI-Lösungen bewerten, priorisieren und ihre Umsetzung gemeinsam mit dem Team vorantreiben.
  • Roadmap und Wirkung steuern: Prioritäten datenbasiert setzen, relevante Kennzahlen etablieren und die Ergebnisse für die nächsten Schritte nutzen.
  • Gründer und CEO beraten: Als unternehmerische Sparringspartnerin oder unternehmerischer Sparringspartner die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens mitgestalten.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung als CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Technology oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle – idealerweise im FinTech- oder Banking-Umfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im technischen Vertrieb an C‑Level-Kundinnen und -Kunden: Du hast Verkaufschancen selbst entwickelt und bis zum Abschluss oder zur konkreten Geschäftsentwicklung begleitet.
  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk in der Banking- und FinTech-Branche und Erfahrung darin, es für Kundenbeziehungen, Partnerschaften oder Wachstum einzusetzen.
  • Eigene Verantwortung für kommerzielle Ergebnisse, zum Beispiel Umsatzwachstum, Geschäftsentwicklung, neue Kundensegmente oder den Ausbau strategischer Accounts.
  • Einen fundierten technischen Hintergrund in Cloud-Architekturen, APIs und KI/ML, etwa mit AWS, Azure oder GCP sowie REST oder GraphQL.
  • Strategische und visionäre Stärke, gepaart mit einer praktischen Hands-on-Mentalität.Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Die Rolle passt weniger gut, wenn …

  • du bisher keinen technischen Vertrieb mit C‑Level-Kundinnen und -Kunden verantwortet hast.
  • dir ein belastbares Netzwerk in Banking oder FinTech und praktische Erfahrung mit Kunden aus diesen Branchen fehlen.
  • du ausschließlich Technologie- oder Teamverantwortung hattest, ohne kommerzielle Wachstumsziele mitzugestalten.
  • du vor allem konzeptionell gearbeitet hast und wenig Erfahrung in der Umsetzung mitbringst.
  • deine Gehaltsvorstellung deutlich über dem angegebenen Rahmen liegt.

Benefits

  • 90.000–120.000 € Jahresgehalt sowie Jahresbonus.
  • Remote-first-Arbeitsmodell in Deutschland, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Workation-Option.30 Urlaubstage sowie zusätzlich der 24. und 31. Dezember frei.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Austausch mit Gründer und CEO.
  • Moderne Cloud-, API- und KI-Technologien.
  • VESOP-Beteiligung sowie Jubiläums- und Geburtstagsgeschenke.
  • Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung.
  • JobRad, JobTicket, Bikeleasing und EGYM Wellpass.
  • Vergünstigte Fitness- und Wellnessangebote.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technologische Zukunft eines europäischen FinTech‑Pioniers
  • Dein Einfluss reicht vom Code bis zum C‑Level‑Vertrieb – seltene Kombination
  • Modernster AI‑Stack liefert täglich neue Lern‑ und Innovationschancen
  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Chief Technology Officer – Customer-Centric Business Development / FinTech (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel CTO, Head of Technology, VP Engineering heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung im FinTech‑Umfeld mitbringst und eine Hands‑on‑Mentalität sowie C‑Level‑Kommunikationsstärke besitzt.

title: Internship Product Management Energy Products & Tariffs (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you will play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value.

  • Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.
  • Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.
  • Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Market & Domain Exposure:

  • Previous experience or knowledge of the energy market is a plus but we are happy to get you up to speed - it’s the motivation that counts!

Benefits
